component.name: Karambola
component.summary: Help Karambola rescue his emotional fruit people friends from the power of dark thoughts
Ayuda a Karambola en su búsqueda de rescatar a sus delicados amigos frutas-personas de los poderes de los pensamientos oscuros en esta breve aventura de acertijos Apunta y Clic dibujada a mano
Ayudad a Karambola en su búsqueda de rescatar a sus delicados amigos frutas-personas de los poderes de los pensamientos oscuros en esta breve aventura de acertijos Apuntar y Clic dibujada a mano
Aiuta Karambola nella sua missione per salvare i suoi emotivi amici „fruttabitanti” dal potere dei pensieri oscuri in questa breve avventura rompicapo punta-e-clicca disegnata a mano
Pomóż Karamboli uratować jego emocjonalnych owocoprzyjaciół od potęgi mrocznych myśli w tej krótkiej, ręcznie ilustrowanej przygodówko-łamigłówce typu point-and-click
Ajude Karambola em sua jornada para resgatar seus delicados amigos pessoas-fruta dos poderes de pensamentos sombrios nessa curta aventura point-and-click, quebra-cabeça e desenhada a mão
Помоги Карамболе в ее стремлении спасти своих эмоциональных фрукто-друзей от власти темных мыслей в этой короткой нарисованной от руки приключенческой головоломке
Bu kısa elle çizilmiş, point & click bulmaca macerasında, Karambola’nın duygusal meyve-insan arkadaşlarını karanlık düşüncelerin gücünden kurtarma arayışında ona yardım edin.
这是一款简短的手绘点击解密冒险游戏，你要做的是帮助杨桃头救出他的朋友，让他们不再被负面的情绪所吞噬

description.p: In the middle of the summer, a pack of evil bird-thoughts attacked a peaceful village of emotional fruit-people. They have been separated, each sent into a different season, focused on their own loneliness and internal landscape of troubles. If you wish, help Karambola on his quest to rescue his friends from the power of dark thoughts.

Karambola is Agata Nawrot’s debut, nominated for A MAZE Awards in 2017, officially selected for festivals NowPlayThis and Digital Cultures. It’s a short surreal story for point-and-click adventure lovers and gentle souls, contains logical puzzles, handmade graphics, original music, and is altogether a rather contemplative and heartwarming experience.

A mediados de verano, una bandada de malvadas aves-pensamientos atacó una pacífica aldea de delicadas frutas-personas. Fueron separadas, cada una enviada a una estación distinta, enfocadas en su propia soledad y paisaje interno de problemas. Si deseas, ayuda a Karambola en su búsqueda de rescatar a sus amigos de los poderes de los pensamientos oscuros.

Karambola es el primer juego de Agata Nawrot, nominado al A MAZE Awards en 2017, seleccionado oficialmente para los festivales NowPlayThis y Digital Cultures. Es una breve historia surrealista para los amantes de los juegos Apuntar y Clic y almas bondadosas; contiene acertijos lógicos, gráficos hechos a mano, música original, y, en general, es una experiencia bastante contemplativa y conmovedora.

A mediados de verano, una bandada de malvadas aves-pensamientos atacó una pacífica aldea de delicadas frutas-personas. Fueron separadas, cada una enviada a una estación distinta, enfocadas en su propia soledad y paisaje interno de problemas. Si deseáis, ayudad a Karambola en su búsqueda de rescatar a sus amigos de los poderes de los pensamientos oscuros.

Karambola es el primer juego de Agata Nawrot, nominado al A MAZE Awards en 2017, seleccionado oficialmente para los festivales NowPlayThis y Digital Cultures. Es una breve historia surrealista para los amantes de los juegos Apuntar y Clic y almas bondadosas; contiene acertijos lógicos, gráficos hechos a mano, música original, y, en general, es una experiencia bastante contemplativa y conmovedora.

In piena estate, uno stormo di malvagi pensier-uccelli attaccò un pacifico villaggio di „fruttabitanti” emotivi. Quest’ultimi sono stati separati, ognuno mandato in una stagione diversa, concentrati sulla propria solitudine e panorama interiore di problemi. Se desideri, aiuta Karambola nella sua missione per salvare i suoi amici dal potere dei pensieri oscuri.

Karambola è il debutto di Agata Nawrot, nominato agli A MAZE Awards nel 2017, ufficialmente selezionato per i festival NowPlayThis e Digital Cultures. È una breve storia surreale per gli amanti delle avventure punta-e-clicca e per anime gentili, contiene enigmi logici, grafica fatta a mano, musica originale ed è nel complesso un’esperienza piuttosto contemplativa e toccante.

W środku lata, stado złowieszczych ptakomyśli zaatakowało spokojną wioskę emocjonalnych owocoludzi. Zostali oddzieleni od siebie, każdy wysłany w inną porę roku, skoncentrowany na swojej samotności i wewnętrznym krajobrazie problemów. Jeśli chcesz, pomóż Karamboli uratować swoich przyjaciół spod potęgi mrocznych myśli.

Karambola to debiut Agaty Nawrot, nominowany do nagrody A MAZE w Berlinie w 2017 r., a także część oficjalnej selekcji na festiwalach NowPlayThis w Londynie i Digital Cultures w Warszawie. To krótka, surrealistyczna historia dla wielbicieli przygodówek oraz łagodnych dusz, zawiera łamigłówki logiczne, ręcznie rysowane grafiki, oryginalną muzykę, które tworzą razem kontemplacyjne, podnoszące na duchu doświadczenie.

Durante o verão, um bando de aves-pensamento malignas atacaram um vilarejo pacífico de delicadas pessoas-fruta. Eles foram separados, cada um enviado para uma estação diferente, focados em sua própria solidão e cenário de problemas. Se você quiser, ajude Karambola em sua jornada para resgatar seus amigos dos poderes dos pensamentos sombrios.

Karambola é o primeiro jogo de Agata Nawrot, indicado para um Prêmio A MAZE em 2017, oficialmente selecionado para os festivais NowPlayThis e Digital Cultures. É uma história curta e surrealista para amantes de aventuras point-and-click e almas gentis, contém quebra-cabeças de lógica, gráficos feitos à mão, música original, e é uma experiência absolutamente contemplativa e emocionante.

В середине лета стая злых птиц-мыслей напала на мирную деревню эмоциональных фрукто-людей. Они были разделены, каждый был отправлен в другое время года, сосредоточившись на своем одиночестве и внутреннем горизонте проблем. Если захочешь, помоги Карамболе в ее стремлении спасти своих друзей от власти темных мыслей.

Карамбола — это дебют Агаты Наврот, номинированный на премию A MAZE Awards в 2017 году, официально отобранный для участия в фестивалях NowPlayThis и Digital Cultures. Это короткая сюрреалистическая история для любителей point-and-click приключений и нежных душ, которая содержит логические головоломки, созданную от руки графику, оригинальную музыку и в целом представляет собой довольно созерцательный и согревающий душу опыт.

Yazın ortasında, bir sürü kötü kuş düşüncesi, duygusal meyve-insanlarından oluşan huzurlu bir köye saldırdı. Ayrıldılar. Her biri, farklı bir mevsime gönderildi, kendi yalnızlıklarına ve sorunların iç manzarasına odaklandı. Dilersen, Karambola’nın arkadaşlarını kötü düşüncelerin gücünden kurtarma görevinde ona yardım et.

Karambola Agata Nawrot’un 2017’de A MAZE Awards’a aday gösterilmiş, NowPlayThis ve Digital Cultures festivalleri için resmi olarak seçilmiş ilk oyunudur. Bu, point & click sevenler ve nazik ruhlar için, mantıksal bulmacalar, el yapımı grafikler, orijinal müzik içeren, kısa bir gerçeküstü hikaye ve tamamen düşündürücü ve iç açıcı bir deneyimdir.
仲夏时节，害怕飞鸟的恐惧心理在宁静的村庄蔓延，吓坏了多愁善感的水果人。他们各奔天涯，去往了不同的季节，孤独的生活就此开始，内心的波澜无法平息。如果你愿意，请帮助杨桃头拯救朋友，让他们不再受恶念侵扰。
《杨桃头》是 Agata Nawrot 的处女作，曾获得 2017 年 A MAZE Awards 提名，正式入选 NowPlayThis 和 Digital Cultures 音乐节。这是一个简短的充满超现实主义的故事，游戏里有逻辑谜题，手工制作的图形、原创音乐，可谓是一款可以启发人们思考，安抚情绪的游戏，非常适合爱好操作简单的点击式玩法、喜欢冒险内容、希望故事情节充满柔情的玩家。

Albion Online is a sandbox MMORPG set in an open medieval fantasy world. It has a fully player-driven economy; all equipment items are player-crafted. You can freely combine armor pieces and weapons in our unique classless system – you are what you wear. Explore the world and tackle challenging PvE content. Engage other adventurers in small- or large-scale PvP, and conquer territories. Gather. Craft. Trade. Conquer. Leave your mark in the world.

Nexuiz Classic is a fast-paced 3D deathmatch game with high-end and complex graphics effects. It is intended to be played over the Internet or over a local network. Several different game types, such as classic deathmatch, team deathmatch and capture the flag are available. It also supports a single-player mode and playing against the computer.
The game brings deathmatch back to the basics, with perfect weapon balancing and fast paced action, keeping itself away from the current trend of realistic shooters.
This game was originally released as "Nexuiz", but is now referred to as "Nexuiz Classic" since the Nexuiz name was re-used for a non-free game for consoles.

Settings, history, and function library can be synchronized with cloud storage of your choice

مع واجهة بسيطة وبديهية، يمكن للمستخدمين الوصول إلى أنشطة تفاعلية وموارد تعليمية واختبارات وألعاب مصغرة تجعل التعلم ممتعًا وتدريجيًا وممتعًا.

ul.li: إكمال أنشطة التعلم التفاعلية.
الوصول إلى موارد تعليمية إضافية.
أداء الاختبارات لتقييم معرفتهم.
اللعب بألعاب مصغرة تعليمية.
إكمال التحديات التي تشجع على التفكير النقدي والإبداع والاستقلالية.
تتبع تقدمهم في التعلم بمرور الوقت.

للمعلمين الوصول إلى نفس المحتوى التعليمي الذي يصل إليه الطلاب، مع القدرة الإضافية على:

description.p: Pixel Junior متكامل تمامًا مع كتاب "Pixel Informatique et Ingénierie"، مما يوسع نطاق التعلم خارج الفصل الدراسي.
سواء كنت طالبًا أو معلمًا، يوفر Pixel Junior بيئة تعلم كاملة وتفاعلية ومتطورة تجعل علوم الحاسوب أكثر جاذبية وسهولة في الوصول إليها.
مع Pixel Junior، يصبح تعلم وتعليم علوم الحاسوب أسهل وأكثر تفاعلية ومتعة.
Note: The application interface is currently available only in French and English. Arabic translations are planned and will be added in a future update.
Pixel Junior is the official companion app for the "Pixel Computer Science and Engineering" textbook, designed to support both students and teachers in learning computer science.
With a simple and intuitive interface, users can access interactive activities, educational resources, quizzes, and mini-games that make learning engaging, progressive, and fun.
For Students
Students can:

ul.li: Complete interactive learning activities.
Access additional educational resources.
Take quizzes to test their knowledge.
Play educational mini-games.
Complete challenges that encourage critical thinking, creativity, and independence.
Track their learning progress over time.

description.p: For Teachers
Teachers have access to the same educational content as students, with the added ability to:

ul.li: Access learning materials for every grade level.
Easily switch between grade levels to explore the corresponding content.
Browse activities, quizzes, educational resources, and mini-games to help prepare their lessons.
A Complete Learning Experience

description.p: Pixel Junior is fully integrated with the "Pixel Computer Science and Engineering" textbook, extending learning beyond the classroom.
Whether you're a student or a teacher, Pixel Junior provides a complete, interactive, and evolving learning environment that makes computer science more engaging and accessible.
With Pixel Junior, learning and teaching computer science becomes easier, more interactive, and more enjoyable.
Remarque : l'interface de l'application est actuellement disponible uniquement en français et en anglais. Des traductions en arabe sont prévues et seront ajoutées dans une prochaine mise à jour.
Pixel Junior est l'application compagnon officielle du manuel "Pixel Informatique et Ingénierie", conçue pour soutenir à la fois les élèves et les enseignants dans l'apprentissage de l'informatique.

Avec une interface simple et intuitive, les utilisateurs peuvent accéder à des activités interactives, des ressources pédagogiques, des quiz et des mini-jeux qui rendent l'apprentissage engageant, progressif et amusant.
Pour les élèves
Les élèves peuvent :

ul.li: Compléter des activités d'apprentissage interactives.
Accéder à des ressources pédagogiques supplémentaires.
Passer des quiz pour tester leurs connaissances.
Jouer à des mini-jeux éducatifs.
Relever des défis qui encouragent la pensée critique, la créativité et l'autonomie.
Suivre leur progression d'apprentissage au fil du temps.

description.p: Pour les enseignants
Les enseignants ont accès au même contenu éducatif que les élèves, avec la possibilité supplémentaire de :

ul.li: Accéder aux supports d'apprentissage pour chaque niveau scolaire.
Changer facilement de niveau scolaire pour explorer le contenu correspondant.
Parcourir les activités, les quiz, les ressources pédagogiques et les mini-jeux pour aider à préparer leurs leçons.
Une expérience d'apprentissage complète

description.p: Pixel Junior est entièrement intégré au manuel "Pixel Informatique et Ingénierie", étendant l'apprentissage au-delà de la salle de classe.
Que vous soyez étudiant ou enseignant, Pixel Junior offre un environnement d'apprentissage complet, interactif et évolutif qui rend l'informatique plus engageante et accessible.
Avec Pixel Junior, l'apprentissage et l'enseignement de l'informatique deviennent plus faciles, plus interactifs et plus agréables.

Pixel Junior Prof is an application dedicated to teachers, designed to provide comprehensive management of their students' accounts. With this application, teachers can control and customize the content their students see on their accounts, provide them with tailored resources, and track their progress.
Key features:

ul.li: Account management: Control and adjust what each student can see and access.
Access to educational resources: Find courses, activities and complementary documents to enrich learning.
Progress tracking: View your students' progress, identify their needs, and adjust content accordingly.

description.p: Pixel Junior Prof is the essential tool to support teachers in supervising and personalizing their students' learning experience.
Remarque : l'interface de l'application est actuellement disponible uniquement en français. Des traductions en anglais et en arabe sont prévues et seront ajoutées dans une prochaine mise à jour.

Pixel Junior Prof est une application dédiée aux enseignants, conçue pour offrir une gestion complète des comptes de leurs élèves. Grâce à cette application, les enseignants peuvent contrôler et personnaliser le contenu que leurs élèves voient sur leurs comptes, leur fournir des ressources adaptées, et suivre leur progression.
Fonctionnalités clés :

ul.li: Gestion des comptes élèves : Contrôlez et ajustez ce que chaque élève peut voir et accéder.
Accès aux ressources pédagogiques : Trouvez des cours, activités et documents complémentaires pour enrichir l’apprentissage.
Suivi de la progression : Visualisez les progrès de vos élèves, identifiez leurs besoins et ajustez le contenu en conséquence.

description.p: Pixel Junior Prof est l'outil indispensable pour accompagner les enseignants dans l'encadrement et la personnalisation de l’expérience d'apprentissage de leurs élèves.

AloxBook is a desktop app that makes personal double-entry bookkeeping easy. See where your money comes from, where it goes, and how your accounts develop. Password protection is optional. When a password is set, SQLCipher encrypts the book with AES-256; without a password, the book is an unencrypted SQLite database. Forgotten passwords cannot be recovered.

Organize your finances in a hierarchical account tree, import CSV files with reusable profiles, create transaction templates, and start a new period with Close and Carry Forward. Switch between five interface languages without restarting.
Linux packages support both native Wayland and X11 desktop sessions.

AloxBook ist eine Desktop-App, die doppelte Buchführung für private Finanzen einfach macht. Sieh, woher Dein Geld kommt, wohin es geht und wie sich Deine Konten entwickeln. Der Passwortschutz ist optional. Wenn ein Passwort gesetzt ist, verschlüsselt SQLCipher das Buch mit AES-256; ohne Passwort ist das Buch eine unverschlüsselte SQLite-Datenbank. Vergessene Passwörter können nicht wiederhergestellt werden.

Organisiere Deine Finanzen in einem hierarchischen Kontenbaum, importiere CSV-Dateien mit wiederverwendbaren Profilen, erstelle Transaktionsvorlagen und starte mit Abschließen und Übertragen eine neue Periode. Für die Oberfläche stehen fünf Sprachen zur Wahl, zwischen denen Du ohne Neustart wechseln kannst.
Linux-Pakete unterstützen native Wayland- und X11-Desktop-Sitzungen.

AloxBook es una aplicación de escritorio que simplifica la contabilidad personal por partida doble. Ve de dónde viene tu dinero, adónde va y cómo evolucionan tus cuentas. La protección con contraseña es opcional. Cuando se establece una contraseña, SQLCipher cifra el libro con AES-256; sin contraseña, el libro es una base de datos SQLite sin cifrar. Las contraseñas olvidadas no se pueden recuperar.

Organiza tus finanzas en un árbol de cuentas, importa archivos CSV mediante perfiles reutilizables, crea plantillas de transacciones y empieza un nuevo periodo con Cerrar y traspasar. La interfaz está disponible en cinco idiomas y puedes cambiar de uno a otro sin reiniciar.
Los paquetes de Linux admiten sesiones de escritorio nativas de Wayland y X11.

AloxBook est une application de bureau qui simplifie la comptabilité personnelle en partie double. Voyez d'où vient votre argent, où il va et comment vos comptes évoluent. La protection par mot de passe est facultative. Lorsqu’un mot de passe est défini, SQLCipher chiffre le livre en AES-256 ; sans mot de passe, le livre est une base de données SQLite non chiffrée. Les mots de passe oubliés ne peuvent pas être récupérés.

Organisez vos finances dans un plan de comptes hiérarchique, importez des fichiers CSV avec des profils réutilisables, créez des modèles de transactions et démarrez une nouvelle période avec Clôture et report. L'interface est disponible en cinq langues et vous pouvez passer de l'une à l'autre sans redémarrer.
Les paquets Linux prennent en charge les sessions de bureau Wayland natives et X11.

AloxBook è un'app desktop che semplifica la contabilità personale in partita doppia. Scopri da dove arriva il tuo denaro, dove va e come cambiano i saldi dei tuoi conti. La protezione con password è facoltativa. Quando viene impostata una password, SQLCipher cifra il libro con AES-256; senza password, il libro è un database SQLite non cifrato. Le password dimenticate non possono essere recuperate.

Organizza le tue finanze in un albero dei conti, importa file CSV usando profili riutilizzabili, crea modelli di transazione e passa a un nuovo periodo con Chiudi e riporta. L'interfaccia è disponibile in cinque lingue e puoi passare dall'una all'altra senza riavviare l'app.
I pacchetti Linux supportano sessioni desktop Wayland native e X11.
Adds bulk transaction editing, light and dark appearances, and a refreshed interface.

ul.li: Edit multiple selected transactions together with a clear review before saving.
Choose System, Light, or Dark appearance throughout the app.
Database lock files are now stored in local application data instead of beside the book.
Template toolbar actions now recover after closing and reopening a book.

description.p: Führt die Sammelbearbeitung von Buchungen, helle und dunkle Darstellungen sowie eine modernisierte Oberfläche ein.

ul.li: Bearbeiten Sie mehrere ausgewählte Buchungen gemeinsam mit einer übersichtlichen Prüfung vor dem Speichern.
Wählen Sie für die gesamte App die Darstellung System, Hell oder Dunkel.
Datenbank-Sperrdateien werden jetzt in den lokalen Anwendungsdaten statt neben der Buchdatei gespeichert.
Vorlagenaktionen bleiben nach dem Schließen und erneuten Öffnen eines Buches verfügbar.

Los archivos de bloqueo de la base de datos ahora se guardan en los datos locales de la aplicación, en lugar de junto al archivo del libro.
Las acciones de plantillas siguen disponibles tras cerrar y reabrir un libro.

description.p: Ajoute la modification groupée des transactions, les apparences claire et sombre et une interface modernisée.

ul.li: Modifiez ensemble plusieurs transactions sélectionnées avec une vérification claire avant l’enregistrement.
Choisissez l’apparence Système, Clair ou Sombre dans toute l’application.
Les fichiers de verrouillage de la base de données sont désormais stockés dans les données locales de l’application plutôt qu’à côté du fichier du livre.
Les actions des modèles restent disponibles après fermeture et réouverture d’un livre.

description.p: Aggiunge la modifica in massa delle transazioni, i temi chiaro e scuro e un’interfaccia rinnovata.

ul.li: Modifica insieme più transazioni selezionate con una verifica chiara prima del salvataggio.
Scegli l’aspetto Sistema, Chiaro o Scuro in tutta l’app.
I file di blocco del database vengono ora archiviati nei dati locali dell’applicazione anziché accanto al file del libro.
Le azioni dei modelli restano disponibili dopo la chiusura e riapertura di un libro.

description.p: Adds bulk transaction deletion and improves CSV importing on Linux.

CSV import supports more bank formats and skips zero-amount rows.
Flatpak imports now show file names instead of temporary portal paths.

description.p: Ermöglicht das Löschen mehrerer Transaktionen und verbessert den CSV-Import unter Linux.

Flatpak-Importe zeigen jetzt Dateinamen statt temporärer Portalpfade.

description.p: Añade la eliminación conjunta de transacciones y mejora la importación CSV en Linux.

ul.li: Ahora se pueden seleccionar y eliminar varias transacciones a la vez.
La importación CSV admite más formatos bancarios y omite los importes cero.
Las importaciones Flatpak muestran ahora el nombre del archivo, no una ruta temporal.

description.p: Ajoute la suppression groupée de transactions et améliore l’import CSV sous Linux.

L’import CSV prend en charge davantage de formats bancaires et ignore les montants nuls.
Les imports Flatpak affichent désormais le nom du fichier plutôt qu’un chemin temporaire.

description.p: Aggiunge l’eliminazione multipla delle transazioni e migliora l’importazione CSV su Linux.

ul.li: È ora possibile selezionare ed eliminare più transazioni insieme.
L’importazione CSV supporta più formati bancari e ignora gli importi pari a zero.
Le importazioni Flatpak ora mostrano il nome del file anziché un percorso temporaneo.

AloxBook is now available in Italian.
Flatpak packages now run natively on Wayland with X11 compatibility.

description.p: Ergänzt eine schnellere CSV-Prüfung, Italienisch und native Wayland-Unterstützung.

AloxBook ist nun auf Italienisch verfügbar.

AloxBook ya está disponible en italiano.
Los paquetes Flatpak funcionan ahora de forma nativa en Wayland y siguen siendo compatibles con X11.

description.p: Ajoute une vérification CSV plus rapide, l’italien et la prise en charge native de Wayland.

AloxBook est désormais disponible en italien.
Les paquets Flatpak fonctionnent désormais nativement sous Wayland tout en restant compatibles avec X11.

description.p: Aggiunge una verifica CSV più rapida, l’italiano e il supporto nativo per Wayland.

AloxBook è ora disponibile in italiano.
I pacchetti Flatpak funzionano ora nativamente su Wayland e restano compatibili con X11.

description.p: A major update with a new Charts tab, a modernized interface, and far smarter CSV import.

ul.li: New Charts tab for spending by category and net assets over time.
Modernized, faster interface, now also available in Spanish.
Smarter worldwide CSV import, with CSV export from the evaluations.

ul.li: Neuer Diagramme-Tab für Ausgaben nach Kategorie und Vermögensentwicklung.

component.name: Artemis
component.summary: The reference for radio signal identification

description.p: Artemis is a software designed to assist radio frequency (RF) signal identification and storage. It simplifies real-time spectrum analysis by leveraging one of the most extensive and community-driven databases, containing over 500 recognized signals. This comprehensive software solution allows users to collect RF signals with specific parameters such as frequency, bandwidth, modulation, etc. Users can also store spectrum waterfalls, audio samples, and all types of documents for future reference. Artemis provides a robust platform to manage a wide range of RF data with precision and ease.

Artemis enhances RF propagation analysis with comprehensive space weather tracking. It offers near real-time (5-minute) data and forecasts to help users anticipate the effects of solar and geomagnetic conditions on RF communications.

screenshot.caption: Main application interface showing RF signal identification
Signal search engine with advanced filtering options
Current space weather conditions and RF propagation summary
Comprehensive 3-day space weather forecast and alerts
Aurora forecast based on the OVATION model
Near real-time solar imaging using multiple GOES and HMI instruments

description.p: This release introduces officially signed Windows binaries, High DPI scaling support, a significant database layer refactoring using Peewee ORM with structured migrations, and key stability fixes.

ul.li: Added a badge in the DB manager to show which database is currently loaded
Added a new field for each signal, including dedicated filtering, to track the specific database version in which the signal was introduced
Added digitally signed Windows binaries (x86 and ARM64) via SignPath Foundation to establish application trust
Added support for High DPI scaling to improve interface clarity on high-resolution displays
Refactored the database layer from raw SQL queries to Peewee ORM to improve code maintainability
Implemented a structured migration system to ensure full backward compatibility with existing databases
Fixed a regression regarding the helper function to use up/down keys to navigate the signal list
Moved resources import to main to fix resolution issues during Nuitka builds, ensuring the application icon appears in the taskbar
Fixed the preview switch behavior to ensure it works properly (#86)
Fixed the bandBar behavior to reset properly when the frequency is undefined

description.p: This release introduces native support for Arch Linux, a completely overhauled GUI for a more modern experience, and important bug fixes for the download module and database updates.

ul.li: Added indicator if a DB and/or Artemis update is available on the main menu
Added native support and official packages for Arch Linux and derived distributions utilizing the pacman package manager
Added official support and binaries (.pkg.tar.zst) for x64 arch-based distros along rpm and deb packages (#83)
Completely overhauled the GUI for a more modern and fluid user experience
Filters have been moved to the top menu for future implementation of new filtering functions
Minor changes to the settings for logging and system-specific environment variables
Download module has been refactored to mitigate bugs on edge cases
Resolved an issue where database updates were blocked if the application was not running the latest version (#76)

description.p: This release extends platform support, improves documentation, and includes maintenance updates and fixes.

ul.li: Extended support for Windows ARM64 architecture
Added .rpm and .deb packages for Linux x64
Artemis is now available directly on Flathub for Linux x64 and Linux ARM64
Added CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, and SECURITY.md
Updated general dependencies
Migrated documentation from MkDocs to Zensical
Fixed automatic updates for Windows ARM64

description.p: This release introduces a new audio setting panel, device selection, and advanced products for the space weather module.

ul.li: Created a setting panel for the audio player
Added selection of the audio output device
Added Sun Synoptic Analysis (SAS) to the space weather module
Added GOES Solar Ultraviolet Imager (SUVI) for all wavelengths (94 Å, 131 Å, 171 Å, 195 Å, 284 Å, 304 Å)
Added GOES Thematic Map from SUVI
Added Large Angle and Spectrometric Coronagraph (LASCO) C2/C3 range for optical imaging of the Sun's corona
Added Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager (HMI) products: Magnetogram, Intensitygram, Dopplergram
Fixed margins for downloader window

Multi-rekening ondersteuning: Hê verskeie rekeninge gelyktydig aangemeld.
Vanlyn bestuur: Voeg items en sends by, wysig en bekyk jou kluis vanlyn.

Datarugsteun: Bestuur outomaties \'n bewaarplek vir kluisrugsteune, insluitend aanhangsels.

description.p: تطبيق عميل متعدد لمنصة Bitwarden® وKeePass (KDBX)، صُمّم لتقديم أفضل تجربة مستخدم ممكنة.
يمكن استخدامه مع أي تثبيت لـ Bitwarden®. هذا المنتج غير مرتبط بمشروع Bitwarden ولا بشركة Bitwarden, Inc. Bitwarden® علامة تجارية مسجلة لشركة Bitwarden Inc.
أبرز الميزات:

ul.li: واجهة جميلة: واجهة مستخدم غنية وسريعة الاستجابة بتصميم Material You، مع مظهرين فاتح وداكن.
بحث متقدم: إمكانات بحث قوية وسريعة.
برج المراقبة: يكتشف كلمات المرور المخترقة والحسابات الضعيفة وكلمات المرور المعاد استخدامها والمصادقة الثنائية غير النشطة والمواقع غير الآمنة والعناصر المكررة أو التي تنتهي صلاحيتها، وغير ذلك.
دعم حسابات متعددة: يمكنك تسجيل الدخول إلى عدة حسابات في الوقت نفسه.
الإدارة دون اتصال: أضف العناصر وعمليات الإرسال وعدّلها، واعرض قبوك، كل ذلك دون اتصال.
تصدير البيانات: صدّر العناصر الفردية أو عناصر المنظمة، بما في ذلك المرفقات.
النسخ الاحتياطي للبيانات: إدارة مستودع النسخ الاحتياطي للقبو تلقائيًا، بما يشمل المرفقات.
المولّد: أنشئ كلمات مرور ومفاتيح SSH وGPG ووكلاء بريد إلكتروني، مع دعم قوائم كلمات مخصّصة.
معاينة المرفقات: عارض آمن داخل التطبيق لمرفقات الصور والنصوص.
وكيل SSH: المصادقة للاتصال بالخوادم، وتوقيع التزامات Git، والتفاعل مع الخدمات القائمة على SSH.
الميزات المتقدمة: دعم الاختصارات والعناصر النائبة للحقول وتجاوزات عناوين URL والحل الذكي للتعارضات.

description.p: বিটওয়ার্ডেন® প্লাটফর্ম এবং কীপাস(KDBX) এর জন্য একটি মাল্টি-ক্লায়েন্ট, যা সম্ভাব্য ব্যবহারকারীকে সর্বোচ্চ অভিজ্ঞতা প্রদানের জন্য ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে।

যেকোনো বিটওয়ার্ডেন® ইনস্টলেশনের সাথে ব্যবহার করা যেতে পারে। এই প্রোডাক্টটি বিটওয়ার্ডেন প্রজেক্ট কিংবা বিটওয়ার্ডেন lnc এর সাথে সম্পৃক্ত নয়। বিটওয়ার্ডেন® হলো বিটওয়ার্ডেন lnc এর একটি নিবন্ধিত ট্রেডমার্ক।
হাইলাইটগুলো:

ul.li: সুন্দর ইন্টারফেস: লাইট/ডার্ক থিমসহ একটি সমৃদ্ধ রেসপন্সিভ ম্যাট‍েরিয়াল ইয়্যু ইউআই।
উন্নত সার্চ: শক্তিশালী এবং খুব দ্রুত সার্চের সক্ষমতা।
ওয়াচটাওয়ার: pwned পাসওয়ার্ড, দুর্বল অ্যাকাউন্ট, পুনরায় ব্যবহার করা পাসওয়ার্ড, বন্ধ থাকা দুই ধাপের যাচাইকরণ, অনিরাপদ ওয়েবসাইট, ডুপ্লিকেট কিংবা মেয়াদোত্তীর্ণ আইটেম এবং আরো অনেক কিছু শনাক্ত করে।
একাধিক-অ্যাকাউন্ট সুবিধা: একইসাথে একাধিক অ্যাকাউন্ট সাইন ইন করা যায়।
অফলাইন ব্যবস্থাপনা: অফলাইনেও আইটেম যুক্ত করা, সেন্ড করা, পরিবর্তন করা, এবং দেখা যায়।
ডাটা এক্সপোর্ট: সংযুক্তি সহ ব্যক্তিগত কিংবা সংগঠনের আইটেম এক্সপোর্ট করুন।
ডাটা ব্যাকআপ: সংযুক্তিসহ একটি ভল্টের ব্যাকআপ রিপোজিটরি স্বংক্রিয়ভাবে সংরক্ষন করুন।
জেনারেটর: কাস্টম শব্দতালিকার সুবিধাসহ পাসওয়ার্ড, SSH কী, এবং ইমেইল ফরোয়ার্ড তৈরি করুন।
সংযুক্তি প্রিভিউ: ছবি ও টেক্সট সংযুক্ত ফাইল নিরাপদভাবে অ্যাপের ভেতরেই দেখার সুবিধা।
SSH এজেন্ট: সার্ভারে যাচাই করা, গিট কমিট সাক্ষর করা, SSH-ভিত্তিক পরিষেবাগুলোর সাথে কাজ করা।
উন্নত বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলো: শর্টকাটের সুবিধা, ফিল্ডের প্লেসহোল্ডার, URL পরিবর্তন করা, এবং স্মার্ট সমস্যার সমাধান।

description.p: Multi-client for the Bitwarden® platform and KeePass (KDBX), designed to provide the best user experience possible.
Can be used with any Bitwarden® installation. This product is not associated with the Bitwarden project nor Bitwarden, Inc. Bitwarden® is a registered trademark of Bitwarden Inc.
Highlights:

ul.li: Beautiful Interface: a rich, responsive Material You UI with Light/Dark themes.
Advanced Search: Powerful and fast search capabilities.
Watchtower: Detects pwned passwords, vulnerable accounts, reused passwords, inactive two-factor authentication, insecure websites, duplicate or expiring items and more.
Multi-Account Support: Simultaneously have multiple accounts signed in.
Offline Management: Add items and sends, modify, and view your vault offline.
Data Export: Export individual or organization items, including attachments.
Data Backup: Automatically manage a vault backup repository, including attachments.
Generator: Create passwords, SSH and GPG keys and email forwarders, with support for custom wordlists.
Attachment Preview: Secure in-app viewer for image and text attachments.
SSH Agent: Authenticating to servers, Signing Git commits, Interacting with SSH-based services.
GPG Agent: Encrypt, decrypt, sign and verify files or messages.
Advanced Features: Support for shortcuts, Field placeholders, URL overrides, and smart conflict resolution.

Funcions avançades: Suport per a dreceres, marcadors de posició de camps, substitucions d\'URL i resolució intel·ligent de conflictes.

Çevrimdışı Yönetim: Çevrimdışı durumdayken ögeler veya gönderiler ekleyin, kasanızı görüntüleyin ve değiştirin.
Veri Dışa Aktarımı: Ekler dahil olmak üzere kişisel ögelerinizi veya organizasyon ögelerinizi dışa aktarın.
Veri Yedekleme: Ekler dahil olmak üzere kasa yedekleme deposunu otomatik olarak yönetin.
Oluşturucu: Özel kelime listesi desteğiyle parolalar, SSH anahtarları ve e-posta yönlendiricileri oluşturun.
Ek Önizleme: Görüntü ve metin eklerini uygulama içinde güvenle görüntüleyin.
SSH Aracısı: Sunucularda kimlik doğrulaması yapın, Git işlemelerini (commits) imzalayın ve SSH tabanlı servislerle etkileşime geçin.
Gelişmiş Özellikler: Kısayollar, alan yer tutucuları (placeholders), URL geçersiz kılmaları (overrides) ve akıllı çakışma çözümü desteği.

description.p: Мультиклієнт для платформи Bitwarden® та KeePass (KDBX), створений для забезпечення найкращого користувацького досвіду.
Може використовуватися з будь-якою інсталяцією Bitwarden®. Bitwarden® є зареєстрованою торговою маркою Bitwarden Inc. Цей продукт не пов’язаний ні з проєктом Bitwarden, ні з Bitwarden, Inc.
Основні можливості:

ul.li: Гарний інтерфейс: багатий, адаптивний інтерфейс Material You зі світлою та темною темами.
Розширений пошук: Потужні та швидкі можливості пошуку.

Вартова вежа: Виявляє скомпрометовані паролі, вразливі облікові записи, повторно використані паролі, неактивну двофакторну автентифікацію, небезпечні вебсайти, дубльовані записи або ті, термін дії яких закінчується, та багато іншого.
Підтримка декількох акаунтів: Одночасний вхід у кілька облікових записів.
Автономний доступ: Додавайте записи та надсилання (Sends), змінюйте та переглядайте своє сховище офлайн.
Експорт даних: Експорт особистих записів або записів організації, включно з вкладеннями.
Резервне копіювання даних: автоматичне керування репозиторієм резервних копій сховища, включно з вкладеннями.
Генератор: Створюйте паролі, SSH-ключі та пересилачі пошти (email forwarders), з підтримкою власних словників.
Попередній перегляд вкладень: безпечний перегляд вкладених зображень і текстових файлів у застосунку.
SSH-агент: автентифікація на серверах, підписування комітів Git і взаємодія зі службами на основі SSH.
Розширені функції: Підтримка клавіатури, перевизначення URL-адрес та розумне вирішення конфліктів.

description.p: Ứng dụng hỗ trợ cả nền tảng Bitwarden® lẫn KeePass (KDBX), được thiết kế để mang lại trải nghiệm người dùng tốt nhất có thể.
Có thể dùng với mọi bản cài đặt Bitwarden®. Sản phẩm này không liên quan đến dự án Bitwarden hay Bitwarden, Inc. Bitwarden® là nhãn hiệu đã đăng ký của Bitwarden Inc.
Điểm nổi bật:

ul.li: Giao diện đẹp mắt: giao diện người dùng Material You phong phú, thích ứng, với chủ đề sáng/tối.
Tìm kiếm nâng cao: khả năng tìm kiếm mạnh mẽ và nhanh chóng.
Tháp canh: Phát hiện mật khẩu bị xâm phạm, tài khoản dễ bị tổn thương, mật khẩu dùng lại, xác thực hai yếu tố chưa bật, trang web không an toàn, mục trùng lặp hoặc sắp hết hạn cùng nhiều vấn đề khác.
Hỗ trợ nhiều tài khoản: Đăng nhập đồng thời vào nhiều tài khoản.
Quản lý ngoại tuyến: Thêm mục và nội dung Gửi; chỉnh sửa và xem kho khi không có mạng.
Xuất dữ liệu: Xuất các mục trong kho cá nhân hoặc kho tổ chức, bao gồm cả tệp đính kèm.
Sao lưu dữ liệu: Tự động quản lý kho bản sao lưu, bao gồm cả tệp đính kèm.
Bộ tạo: Tạo mật khẩu, khóa SSH, khóa GPG và bí danh email được chuyển tiếp, đồng thời hỗ trợ danh sách từ tùy chỉnh.
Xem trước tệp đính kèm: Trình xem an toàn tích hợp trong ứng dụng dành cho tệp đính kèm dạng ảnh và văn bản.
SSH agent: Xác thực với máy chủ, ký các commit Git và tương tác với các dịch vụ dùng SSH.
Tính năng nâng cao: Hỗ trợ lối tắt, chỗ dành sẵn cho trường, ghi đè URL và giải quyết xung đột thông minh.

description.p: Keyguard on macOS now automatically locks your vault when the screen turns off for enhanced security. This update also improves reliability by fixing a crash on older Android versions and increases compatibility on Windows, resolving issues when opening vaults stored in locations with certain folder permissions.

This release introduces GPG public certificate validation and improves SSH and GPG agent reliability on Android. We have also enhanced stability for users running multiple app instances on Windows and fixed an issue to ensure the latest master password is used for authentication. Additionally, syncing local accounts no longer requires an internet connection, and WebDAV sync is more reliable. Linux AppImage builds now support zsync delta updates for faster, smaller updates.

Keyguard for Linux is now available as an AppImage, expanding desktop platform support. This release enhances KDBXv3 database reliability, fixing password decryption for protected attachments, validating AES padding, and correctly handling both compressed and raw attachments. Database schema migrations on desktop platforms are now atomic to prevent data corruption during an upgrade.

This update allows you to export GPG public and private keys as .asc files and unlock KeePass KDBX vaults using only a key file, without a master password. When uploading a GPG key, you can now request a verification email. This release also improves platform stability by ensuring the agent process on Windows shuts down reliably and fixing a crash on Android that could occur if the system file picker was unavailable.

description.p: ATLauncher is a launcher for Minecraft which integrates multiple different modpacks to allow you to download and install modpacks easily and quickly.
ATLauncher has a few nice features including:

ul.li: Allows quick and easy install of modpacks, no more messing around trying to install mods
A range of different packs, and more being added all the time
Multiple instances. Install a pack as many times as you like without messing up a previous install
Multiple accounts allow you to login as different users from the one install
Private instances. This allows you to only install instances under your account so people can't mess up your worlds

Install packs from CurseForge and FTB
Mod management for instances, including auto download and installation of mods, maps and resource packs from CurseForge and Modrinth
Support for both Mojang and Microsoft accounts
More features always being added

description.p: Below is the steps to run this flatpak in a custom directory

ol.li: Open Flatseal
Select ATLauncher on the left
Scroll down to "Filesystem", "Other files"
Add a new entry via the icon with a "folder" and "plus" sign
Input the path you want to let ATLauncher run in. IE `/home/name/Games/ATLauncher`
Scroll down to "Environment", "Variables"
Click the "plus" sign to add a new entry
Write down an enviroment variable, IE `CUSTOM_DIR=/home/name/Games/ATLauncher`
Run ATLauncher
Notice that ATLauncher is now working using CUSTOM_DIR

description.p: Xecrets Ez is a true zero-knowledge desktop file and text encryption application that uses strong AES-256 encryption to password protect your files. Encrypted files use the .axx extension and remain protected wherever they go — cloud storage, email, USB drives or backups — because the encryption always follows the file. No data or passwords will ever leave your device.

Unlike container-based or folder-based encryption solutions, Xecrets Ez encrypts files individually so protection is never lost when a file is moved or copied. It works entirely offline: no internet connection, no servers, no accounts required.
Features include (some require Premium):

ul.li: AES-256 encryption
Encrypt and decrypt individual files or all files in folders
Encrypt text messages directly in the application
Open and edit encrypted files with automatic re-encryption
YubiKey hardware security key support
SLIP-39 Shamir's Secret Sharing for password backup
Available in English, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Español, Português and Svenska
No internet connection is ever used
100% compatible with AxCrypt
Cross-platform: Linux, Windows and macOS

description.p: It is entirely free for encryption and decryption of files, with full security. Premium features require a low-cost subscription with a 10-day free trial. A 3-day premium trial is also available without a credit card.

screenshot.caption: Dashboard overview with projects across multiple DAWs

description.p: Prosty program do generowania kodów uwierzytelniania dwuetapowego.
Funkcje:

ul.li: Obsługa metod na podstawie czasu/licznika/Steam
Obsługa algorytmów SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512
Skanowanie kodów QR za pomocą aparatu lub ze zrzutu ekranu
Blokowanie programu za pomocą hasła
Piękny interfejs

Tworzenie kopii zapasowej/przywracanie z/do znanych programów, takich jak FreeOTP+, Aegis (zaszyfrowane i w zwykłym tekście), andOTP i Google Authenticator

description.p: Aplicação simples para gerar códigos de autenticação de dois fatores.
Funcionalidades:

ul.li: Suporte a métodos Steam/baseados em tempo/baseados em contador
Suporte a algoritmos SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512
Leitor de código QR usando uma câmara ou a partir de uma captura de ecrã
Bloquear a aplicação com uma palavra-passe
Boa interface de utilizador
Provedor de pesquisa GNOME Shell
Efetuar cópia de segurança/Restauro de/para aplicações conhecidas tais como FreeOTP+, Aegis (encriptado / texto-simples), e OTP, Google Authenticator

description.p: Aplicativo simples para gerar códigos de autenticação de dois fatores.
Características:

ul.li: Suporte a métodos Steam/baseados em tempo/baseados em contador
Suporte a algoritmos SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512
Leitor de código QR usando uma câmera ou a partir de uma captura de tela
Bloqueie o aplicativo com uma senha
Uma interface de usuário bonita
O provedor de serviço do GNOME Shell
Faça backup/Restaure de/para aplicativos conhecidos como FreeOTP+, Aegis (criptografado / texto simples), andOTP, Google Authenticator

description.p: O aplicație simplă care generează un cod de autentificare cu doi factori.
Funcționalități:

ul.li: Suport pentru metode bazate pe timp/bazate pe numărare/Steam
Suport pentru algoritmii SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512
Scaner de coduri QR folosind o cameră sau dintr-o captură de ecran
Blochează aplicația cu o parolă
UI frumos
Furnizor de căutare Shell GNOME
Copiază de rezervă/restaurează de la/în aplicațiile cunoscute cum ar fi FreeOTP+, Aegis (criptat / text simplu), andOTP, Autentificator Google

description.p: Простое приложение для генерации кодов двухфакторной аутентификации.
Возможности:

ul.li: Поддержка методов, основанных на Времени/Счетчиках/Steam
Поддержка алгоритмов SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512
Сканер QR-кодов использующий камеру или скриншот
Блокировка приложения с помощью пароля
Прекрасный пользовательский интерфейс
Провайдер поиска GNOME Shell
Резервное копирование/восстановление из/в известные приложения, такие как FreeOTP+, Aegis (зашифрованный/простой текст), andOTP, Google Authenticator

description.p: Jednoduchá aplikácia na generovanie dvojfaktorových autentifikačných kódov.
Funkcie:

ul.li: Podpora metód založených na čase/počítadle/Steam
Podpora algoritmov SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512
Skener kódu QR pomocou fotoaparátu alebo zo snímky obrazovky
Uzamknúť aplikáciu s heslom
Krásne užívateľské rozhranie
Poskytovateľ vyhľadávania v prostredí GNOME Shell
Zálohovať/obnoviť z/do známych aplikácií, ako sú FreeOTP+, Aegis (šifrovaný/jednoduchý text), andOTP, Google Authenticator

description.p: Program za ustvarjanje dvostopenjskih overitvenih kod.
Zmožnosti:

ul.li: Podpora za Steam, časovno, števčno zaklepanje
Podpora algoritmom SHA1/SHA256/SHA512
Bralnik kode QR s kamero ali prek zajete slike zaslona
Zaklepanje programa z geslom
Prefinjen grafični vmesnik
Ponudnik iskanja GNOME Shell
Varnostno kopiranje/obnovitev s podporo uveljavljenih programov, kot so FreeOTP+, Aegis (šifrirano/navadno besedilo), andOTP in Overjevalnik Google (Google Authenticator).

description.p: Једноставан програм за стварање шифара за двофакторног потврђивача.
Одлике:

ul.li: Подршка метода занованих на времену/бројачу/Steam-у
Подршка алгоритама SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512
Скенирање QR кода коришћењем фото-апарата или снимка екрана
Закључавање програма лозинком
Лепо корисничко сучеље
Достављач претраге Гномове шкољке
Прављење/враћање резерве из/у познате програме као што је „FreeOTP+“, „Aegis“ (шифровано / обичан текст), „andOTP“, „Google Authenticator“

description.p: Enkelt program som genererar tvåfaktorsautentiseringskoder.

QR-kodskanner med en kamera eller från en skärmbild
Lås programmet med ett lösenord
Vackert användargränssnitt
GNOME Shell-söktjänsteleverantör
Säkerhetskopiering/återställning från/till kända program som FreeOTP+, Aegis (krypterat/klartext), andOTP, Google Authenticator

คุณลักษณะ:

ul.li: Zaman temelli/Sayaç Temelli/Akış yöntemleri desteği
SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 algoritmalarını destekler
Kamera kullanarak veya ekran görüntüsünden QR kod tarayıcı
Uygulamayı parolayla kilitle
Mükemmel kullanıcı arayüzü
GNOME Kabuk arama sağlayıcısı
FreeOTP+, Aegis (şifreli / düz metin) ve andOTP, Google Authenticator gibi bilinen uygulamalardan Yedekle/Geri Yükle

description.p: Проста програма для створення двофакторних кодів розпізнавання.
Можливості:

ul.li: На основі часу/На основі лічильника/Підтримка методів Steam
Підтримка алгоритмів SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512
Сканування кодів QR за допомогою камери або зі знімка вікна
Замикання програми за допомогою пароля
Чудовий інтерфейс користувача
Надавач даних пошуку GNOME Shell
Резервне копіювання і відновлення даних з резервних копій для відомих програм, зокрема FreeOTP+, Aegis (зашифрований / звичайний текст), andOTP, Google Authenticator

功能：

ul.li: 支持基于时间/计数器的验证方式和 Steam 平台等

可使用密码锁定应用程序
美观的用户界面
支持 GNOME Shell 搜索

description.p: 用於產生雙重認證驗證碼的簡單應用程式。

美觀的使用者界面
整合進 GNOME Shell 的搜尋結果

description.p: Obfuscate дазваляе схаваць вашу асабістую інфармацыю з любога відарыса.
Obfuscate lets you redact your private information from any image.
Ofusca us permet esborrar la informació privada de qualsevol imatge.
Zamlžení vám umožňuje skrývat své soukromé informace v obrázcích.
Sløring lader dig tildække dine private informationer i billeder.
Obfuscate lässt Sie private Informationen in jedem Bild verdecken.
Το Obfuscate σάς επιτρέπει να αναπαράγετε τις προσωπικές σας πληροφορίες από οποιαδήποτε εικόνα.
Obfuscate lets you redact your private information from any image.
Ofuscador le permite ocultar su información privada en cualquier imagen.
Obfuscate aplikazioak zure edozein irudiren informazio pribatua ezkutatzen du.
گنگی می‌گذارد اطّلاعات خصوصیتان را از هر تصویری دربیاورد.
Obfuscate mahdollistaa yksityisten tietojen poistamisen mistä tahansa kuvasta.
Caviardage permet de caviarder les informations privées de n’importe quelle image.
Ofuscar permítelle quitar a información privada de calquera imaxe.
כלי הערפול מאפשר לך להסיר את הפרטים האישיים שלך מכל תמונה שהיא.
'ऑबफ़स्केट' आपको किसी भी छवि से आपकी निजी जानकारी को हटाने में मदद करता है।
Obfuscate vam omogućuje uređivanje vaših privatnih informacija sa svake slike.
Az Obfuszkálás segítségével bármilyen képből eltávolíthatja a személyes információit.
Obfuscate memungkinkan Anda menyusun informasi pribadi Anda dari gambar apapun.
Obfuscate gerir þér kleift að afmá upplýsingar um þig úr hverskyns ljósmyndum.
Obfuscate consente di offuscare le proprie informazioni private da qualsiasi immagine.
Obfuscate は画像の個人情報を黒塗りすることができます。
პროგრამა საშუალებას გაძლევთ ნებისმიერი გამოსახულებიდან წაშალოთ თქვენი პირადი ინფორმაცია.
Ikke alt er like egnet for deling. Obfuscate lar deg fjerne private opplysninger og sensitivt innhold fra bilder, slik at du kan dele dem uten å være redd for å få hemmeligheter på avveie.
Obfuscate laat u uw persoonlijke informatie van afbeeldingen verwijderen.
Enfosquir vos permet de tirar vòstras informacions privadas de quin imatge que siá.
Ten program umożliwia usuwanie prywatnych informacji z każdego obrazu.
O Ofuscador permite-lhe censurar a sua informação privada a partir de qualquer imagem.
O Ofuscar permite que você apague suas informações privadas de qualquer imagem.
Eclipsează vă permite să redactați informațiile private de la orice imagine.
Obfuscate позволяет скрыть личную информацию на любом изображении.
Program omogoča urejanje zasebnih podatkov katerekoli slike.
Замућење вам омогућава да своје приватне податке уредите из било које слике.
Obfuscate låter dig redigera bort din privata information från bilder.
Obfuscate, herhangi bir görüntüdeki bilgilerinizi yeniden düzenlemenizi sağlar.
За допомогою «Затемнення» ви можете прибрати конфіденційну інформацію з будь-якого зображення.
Obfuscate cho phép bạn kiểm duyệt thông tin cá nhân của mình từ bất kỳ hình ảnh nào.
Obfuscate 允许您从任何图像中模糊处理您的私人信息。

component.name: GUPT
component.summary: Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted privacy suite — chat, passwords, notes, bookmarks and ephemeral sharing on Nostr relays.

description.p: GUPT is a self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted privacy suite built on Nostr relays. A privacy-first alternative to Telegram, Signal, WhatsApp, and Discord — that also replaces your password manager, notes app, and bookmarks.

ul.li: Chat: encrypted DMs and groups with replies, reactions, and mentions
Calls: peer-to-peer WebRTC voice, video, and screen sharing
Passwords: encrypted logins with TOTP / 2FA codes and tags
Notes: private Markdown notes with search and tags
Bookmarks: encrypted page saves with the gupt-mark bookmarklet
Secure Share: ephemeral encrypted file and text links — no account needed to open

description.p: Everything is encrypted on your device before it ever leaves it. Relays only store and forward ciphertext, and your identity is a cryptographic keypair you control — not an account someone else can log, suspend, or subpoena.
No servers, no accounts, no phone numbers.

New gupt-sdk bot framework for building encrypted bots with encrypted file support, an in-app public bot directory, invite QR code scanning, relay scoring for smarter relay selection, multiple chat attachments, and a much lighter footprint from fetching IPFS content via originless gateways.
WebRTC end-to-end call verification with SAS emojis, expanded default relay list, brute-force entropy hints during onboarding, and refreshed store screenshots covering the full privacy suite.

Encrypted passwords and notes streams replace the vault, redesigned bookmarks and chat views, single-use token invites, self-healing relay subscriptions, call and screen-share fixes, and a refreshed profile — plus a refreshed store listing with screenshots covering the full privacy suite.
Vault redesign with table layout and templates, bookmarklet hotlink for saving pages, improved notifications, and UI refinements.
Bespoke is a software modular synthesizer. It contains a bunch of modules, which you can connect together to create sounds.
Bespoke is like a DAW* in some ways, but with less of a focus on a global timeline. Instead, it has a design more optimized for jamming and exploration.
Some older bespoke patches (including several of the included example files!) weren't loading
New modules:

ul.li: clockin/clockout: sync bespoke tempo to other devices via midi clock
abletonlink: sync bespoke's tempo to ableton link-enabled apps
songbuilder: pattern control interface to help you turn loops into songs (similar to a tracker's pattern sequencer, but bespokified)
timelinecontrol: take control of bespoke's timeline position
buffershuffler: a new stutter-like tool for slicing up live audio on a grid
...plus a bunch of other utility modules

description.p: Other cool stuff:

ul.li: added right-click quickspawn menu system to improve module spawning workflow
added "drag cable into space" spawn system to speed up patch building workflow
many significant additions to push 2 controller integration
renamed presets module to snapshots module, and reframed it to be more useful as a performance/sequencing tool
added a bunch of OSC support
added looping deterministic modes to notechance, notehocket, and other randomization-driven modules

description.p: Also, fixed a bunch of bugs and crashes.

component.name: Bestatic
component.summary: A simple but powerful static-site generator

description.p: Bestatic is a simple but powerful static-site generator that you can install graphically without worrying about dependencies, on Windows, macOS, and Linux, running on any x86_64 and ARM architectures. It can simply turn your text files into fully functional websites and blogs.

p.em: Any prior knowledge in Python is not required. Neither is any prior knowledge in dependency or environment management.

description.p: It is really minimal yet feature-rich. Like every other static-site generator, it can generate a complete website by processing a bunch of markdown files. As a result, it eliminates the need for server-side programming, databases, and constant security updates. The site that Bestatic generates can be served from any web server or host (or even from Git-based platforms, for completely free).
Some salient features of Bestatic that are probably worth highlighting:

ul.li: Blog-aware. You can easily create your blog/news page along with your website. Customizable list pages for blog posts, reverse chronological order of posts, tags, comments (using Giscus or Disqus), fully customizable URL structures, RSS feeds - All standard good stuff are already included.

Feature-rich out of the box 🎁. Want LaTeX support? Syntax highlighting for code? Powerful search functionality? Auto-reloading server? Configurable navigation? Custom taxonomies (categories, multiple authors, etc.)? Image optimization? Custom handling of CSV and YAML data? We have all these things built-in. Oh yes, unlike many other static-site generators, our multi-column content layout work out of the box.

Flexible and extensible ✨. Want to configure things in your way? Use simple yaml files. Want to use command line? Use our CLI options. Want to theme in your own way? Use standard Jinja2 templating to design freely. Want to use different markdown plugins or maybe your own custom shortcode? All of these things can de done pretty easily, without any prior knowledge or experience.
Scalable. Bestatic ultimately builds a bunch of static files. So, no need for database management, server maintenance, or constant security updates. A hassle-free way to manage large-scale websites.
Free and open-source. Of course, Bestatic is free and open-source, licensed under GNU GPL-3.0. This will remain free and open-source forever.

Simple. Making things simple for you is our goal. Be it via graphical installation, compatibility across operating systems and hardware architectures, dedicated quickstart, or in-depth documentation: We just want to make your Bestatic journey easy and enjoyable for the beginning!

description.p: Getting started: Want to try Bestatic? Download and install it from the release page (separate native installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux) https://github.com/tatsatb/bestatic/releases/latest, or Snap store, or Flathub, or PyPI. Detailed installation instructions, quickstart guide, and user manual are available on our official documentation at https://www.bestaticpy.com.
Release v0.0.36 should be considered as a major release of Bestatic. This is a relatively stable version that should work on both x86-64 and arm64 architectures, running Windows, macOS, or Linux.
IMPORTANT: The documentation for Bestatic has been completely updated and it is now available at the official website. This was a long overdue update and we are glad that it is finally here!!

ul.li: New GUI Installer for macOS: We have brand new GUI based .pkg installer for macOS (separate native packages for Intel and Apple Silicon). In proper Bestatic style, everything is included in a single-executable. Mac users no longer needs to tinker with homebrew/pipx/command line, if they choose not to (of course, CLI is still a valid installation option).

Customizable Port Number: During local testing, users can now specify their port number of choice via --portnumber or -n flag. Previously it was hard coded to 8080 (which is still the default, if that flag is not specified).

Miscellaneous keys can now be added to the bestatic.yaml config file (with extra_data key and any nested keys of choice) and Bestatic will now pass it properly to the templates. This can be really valuable in generating second navigation bar.

Custom Data Handling: In addition to custom description of taxonomies (via _includes/yamls folder), Bestatic can now process user provided CSV and YAML data and pass the structured data theme templates. With proper themes, webpages can be generated with minimal markdown for repetitive/structured content.

Image Optimization module is now available in Bestatic out of the box. This is currently an experimental feature that can be used to optimize image size by automatically converting all images to .webp format. While this would make site builds a bit slower, especially for large images, it would make sites much faster to load.
A test Suite has been added to the codebase.
Linux users who prefer not to use flatpak or snap, can now use native linux installers. The install.sh and uninstall.sh are provided inside the tarball.
Version Updates: Majority of the Python packages have been updated to the newest version. Bestatic now supports Python 3.10-3.14 (all currently maintained Python versions).

New Themes: We have added two new themes to the themes repo: bestatic-lab-group and bestatic-lab-group-simple. These themes are designed for academic lab group websites. All other themes have been updated to use the new features as well.
Quickstart now works even it is tried with a theme other than "Amazing". Fixes issues https://github.com/tatsatb/bestatic/issues/6 and https://github.com/tatsatb/bestatic/issues/7.
Blog pagination has been fixed and more than one pages can be created (it broke during the last release).
Navigation can be correctly configured via Nav parameter, even if separate homepage template is used now.

description.p: Themes are available at the themes repo. Detailed documentation is available at the official website.
As usual, Bestatic can be downloaded and installed from the GitHub release page, or Snap store, or Flathub, or PyPI.
As always, thank you very much for trying Bestatic. ❤️❤️
Full Changelog: https://github.com/tatsatb/bestatic/compare/v0.0.30...v0.0.36

ul.li: Multiple column layouts are now available for all page content. To use it, Inside a markdown header, use splitsection class to split the content into different sections. Bestatic will pass these sections separately (along with your corresponding headings and section index numbers) to your templates. You can then utilize all Jinja2 logic systems to customize your content into dynamic multiple columns (using Bootstrap CSS or something similar). We will soon update Bestatic themes to take advantage of this feature.

Users can now define their own Shortcodes (i.e., macros that can convert simple snippets in contents into per-defined HTML markup) for markdown processing by writing custom Python functions and including them in _shortcodes directory.

In addition to per-existing "tags", users can now define custom taxonomies (for e.g., categories, authors, movies, etc.), generate list page for each of those, and process additional data for each of these taxonomies from .yaml files in _includes/yamls directory. As a result, multiple authors can now have custom pages with their biography and list of authored articles.
The main config.yaml has been renamed as bestatic.yaml. Old config.yaml would still work for now, but it will eventually be depreciated.
Slugs now will be generated automatically as per the filename (of course, user is free to customize it, as usual) when bestatic newpage or bestatic newpost would be used.

Dates and times can now be formatted in the bestatic.yaml using the strftime format (see docs.python.org/3/library/datetime.html#strftime-and-strptime-format-codes and strftime.org for reference) to display those as per users' choice. The "%B %d, %Y" format has been set as a fallback option.

Custom extensions and extension configurations now can be added via bestatic.yaml file. All python-markdown extensions and Pymdown extensions can be used now, along with their individual configurations.
The character length of post summary can now be defined in bestatic.yaml file.
Single posts can be used as homepage.
Navigation can now be simply defined in bestatic.yaml file. It can be as nested as required. With proper themes, users will no longer need to manually edit templates to define the navigation links.
For post items, URL parameter can now be completely user defined (e.g., "blog", "news", "articles", etc.), configurable via bestatic.yaml file. "Posts" will now be the fallback option.
In addition to previous slug and next slug, each post has access to previous and next titles of the posts.
Included markdown-include extension in the Bestatic package so that one markdown file can add content from another markdown file.
The fuse-search tool has been rewritten to include user-defined search-index file link.
Page type contents now can have access to all the Post type content data. This can be enabled in bestatic.yaml file.
The newline attribute has been removed from the sitemap.xml files.
Tags field can now be empty (if the user chooses to not use any tag).
Faulty caching in Bestatic development server has been fixed (which often created issues with Chromium-based browsers).
Time zone can now be set in bestatic.yaml file. The UTC has been set as a fallback option.
Post summaries on list page will no longer have unprocessed HTML tags.
Project Sites on GitHub and GitLab can now be better deployed using -p or --projectsite flag.

description.p: Documentation and themes will be updated accordingly soon.
Release 0.0.30 is essentially same as 0.0.29; previously an outdated file got included. So, we are updating the version to v0.0.30.
Bug fix:

ul.li: Correctly generate the search index when the -p or --projectsite flag is used.

description.p: Added features:

ul.li: Added root-import directory which will be directly copied to the root of the generated site folder (in a nested fashion).
Added the -p or --projectsite flag for correctly deploying the website as a "project site" to a Github pages (or Gitlab pages), even without using any custom domain.
Updated README.md with website links.

description.p: Readest is a modern, feature-rich ebook reader designed for avid readers offering seamless cross-platform access, powerful tools, and an intuitive interface to elevate your reading experience.
Built as a modern rewrite of Foliate, Readest leverages Next.js 15 and Tauri v2 to deliver a smooth, cross-platform experience across macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and the Web.
Whether you're analyzing complex texts, immersing yourself in stories, or exploring new ideas, Readest adapts to your needs with powerful features for deep, thoughtful reading.
Key features include:

ul.li: Multi-format support for EPUB, MOBI, KF8 (AZW3), FB2, CBZ, TXT, and PDF (experimental).
Switch between scrolling or paginated reading modes for your preferred reading style.
Full-text search across the entire book to find relevant sections quickly.
Add highlights, bookmarks, and notes to enhance your reading experience and learning.
Easily excerpt text from books for detailed notes and analysis.
Instantly look up words and terms with built-in dictionary and Wikipedia integration.
Translate selected text instantly using DeepL for accurate translations.
Parallel Reading: Read two books or documents simultaneously in a split-screen view, perfect for researchers, language learners, and multitaskers.
Customize fonts, layout, theme mode, and theme colors for a personalized reading experience.
Cross-platform synchronization of book files, reading progress, notes, and bookmarks across all supported platforms.
Text-to-Speech functionality for a more accessible reading experience.
Organize, sort, and manage your entire ebook library with advanced library management tools.
One-click file association to quickly open files in Readest from your file browser.

description.p: Readest also includes custom CSS support for personalized styling, and code syntax highlighting for technical books. The application is designed to honor the legacy of deep reading while embracing modern technology for an enhanced experience.

component.name: Bitwarden
component.summary: A secure and free password manager for all of your devices

description.p: Bitwarden is the easiest and safest way to store all of your logins and passwords while conveniently keeping them synced between all of your devices.

Password theft is a serious problem. The websites and apps that you use are under attack every day. Security breaches occur and your passwords are stolen. When you reuse the same passwords across apps and websites hackers can easily access your email, bank, and other important accounts.

Security experts recommend that you use a different, randomly generated password for every account that you create. But how do you manage all those passwords? Bitwarden makes it easy for you to create, store, and access your passwords.

Bitwarden stores all of your logins in an encrypted vault that syncs across all of your devices. Since it's fully encrypted before it ever leaves your device, only you have access to your data. Not even the team at Bitwarden can read your data, even if we wanted to. Your data is sealed with AES-256 bit encryption, salted hashing, and PBKDF2 SHA-256.
Bitwarden is 100% open source software. The source code for Bitwarden is hosted on GitHub and everyone is free to review, audit, and contribute to the Bitwarden codebase.

description.p: Це офіційний пакет, опублікований, підтримуваний та забезпечений розробником Boxy SVG.
Boxy SVG 项目的目标是创建最好的 SVG 文件编辑工具。无论对于初学者还是专业设计师和开发人员。可在任何设备和操作系统上使用。

ul.li: 简洁直观的用户界面，深受 Inkscape、Sketch 和 Adobe Illustrator 启发
全面支持画布上编辑对象几何、变换、绘制和其他属性
保存为 SVG 和 SVGZ 格式，导出为 PNG、JPG、WebP、PDF 和 HTML5
与 Pixabay 及其他拥有数百万免费图片和矢量素材的库集成
与 Google Fonts 集成，提供数百种免费字体
超过 100 条命令的可配置键盘快捷键
手动参考线、智能参考线和网格
路径操作（合并、相交、相减、排除、闭合、反转等）
排列操作（对齐、旋转、翻转、排序、分组等）

支持 SVG 精灵编辑

Instant search across all snippets
Notes field for each snippet
100% local storage — all data stays on your device

SafeScript in dark mode showing code snippets

description.p: A big feature update: a Copy Code button, a Find and Replace bar (Ctrl+F), favorites, snippet cloning, moving snippets between folders, and exporting snippets or whole folders to files. Search now looks inside code and notes, not just titles. Drag a file onto the window to turn it into a snippet. Added adjustable editor font size, a current-line highlight, and a status line showing line and character counts and when a snippet was last modified. SafeScript now warns before discarding unsaved edits.
Added Ctrl+N shortcut for new snippet, the app now reopens the last folder and snippet you were viewing, the code and notes divider position is remembered, and a Reset Window Size option was added.
Added database backup and import, Ctrl+S to save the current snippet, and the app now remembers column widths between sessions.
Fixed description field not updating in memory after save.
Brave is on a mission to fix the web by giving users a safer, faster and better browsing experience while growing support for content creators through a new attention-based ecosystem of rewards.
Browse faster by blocking ads and trackers that violate your privacy and cost you time and money.

description.p: Buckets is a private, personal and family budgeting app. All your data stays on your computer.

Buckets comes with an untimed, free trial for as long as you need to decide if it works for you. When you decide to purchase, a one-time payment buys a license for the current major version. The license may be used on any number of devices belonging to your immediate family members living in your home.
