description.p: كاليبر هو الحل ذو المحطة الواحدة لكل احتياجاتك من الكتب الالكترونية.

يمكنك استخدام كاليبر لفهرسة كتبك، وجلب البيانات الوصفية لها تلقائيًا، وتحويلها من وإلى جميع تنسيقات الكتب الإلكترونية المختلفة، وإرسالها إلى أجهزة قراءة الكتب الإلكترونية الخاصة بك، وقراءة الكتب على جهاز الكمبيوتر الخاص بك، وتحرير الكتب في محرر كتب إلكترونية مخصص، وحتى إتاحتها عبر الشبكة باستخدام خادم المحتوى المدمج. يمكنك أيضًا تنزيل الأخبار والدوريات بتنسيق الكتب الإلكترونية من أكثر من ألف موقع إخباري ومجلة مختلفة.
calibre е едното стоп решение на всички ваши нужди от е-книга.

Може да използвате calibre, за да каталогирате книгите сѝ, да докарвате метаданни за тях автоматично, конвертирайте гѝ от и във всички различни формати на е-книги, изпратете гѝ към вашите устройства за четец на е-книги, прочетете книгите на компютъра си, редактирайте книгите в специализиран редактор на е-книги и дори да гѝ предоставите над мрежа с вградения сървър за Съдържание. Може също да изтеглите новини и периодични издания във формат е-книга от над хиляда различни новини и сайтове на магазини.
calibre is the one stop solution to all your e-book needs.

You can use calibre to catalog your books, fetch metadata for them automatically, convert them from and to all the various e-book formats, send them to your e-book reader devices, read the books on your computer, edit the books in a dedicated e-book editor and even make them available over the network with the built-in Content server. You can also download news and periodicals in e-book format from over a thousand different news and magazine websites.
Calibre je jediné řešení pro všechny potřeby vašich e-knih.

Calibre můžete používat pro zařazení vašich knih do katalogu, automatické načítání jejich metadat, jejich převedení z a do všech různých formátů e-knih, jejich odesílání do vašich zařízení čteček e-knih, čtení knih na počítači, úpravě knih ve vyhrazeném editoru a dokonce jejich zpřístupnění na síti pomocí vestavěného Serveru s obsahem. Můžete také stahovat zprávy a periodika ve formátu e-knihy z více než tisíce různých webových stránek se zprávami a časopisy.
Calibre ist die Komplettlösung für Ihre eBook Bedürfnisse.

Mit Calibre können Sie Ihre eBooks verwalten, sie automatisch mit Metadaten anreichern, sie zwischen verschiedenen eBook-Formaten konvertieren und an Ihren Reader senden. Lesen Sie Ihre eBooks direkt im integrierten Reader oder ändern Sie sie im eBook-Editor. Sie können Ihre eBooks mit Hilfe des integrierten Inhalteservers sogar für andere Nutzer in Ihrem Netzwerk verfügbar machen. Mehr als 1000 verschiedene Nachrichten- und Zeitschriften-Websites stehen in Calibre bereits zur Verfügung, um Artikel im eBook-Format herunterzuladen.
calibre es la solución única para todo lo relacionado con libros electrónicos.

Puede usar calibre para catalogar los libros, obtener sus metadatos automáticamente, convertirlos entre los distintos formatos de libro electrónico, enviarlos a los dispositivos de lectura, leer libros en el equipo, modificar los libros en un editor específico e incluso hacer que estén disponibles en línea con el servidor de contenido. También puede descargar noticias y publicaciones periódicas en formato de libro electrónico desde más de mil sitios web de noticias y revistas.
calibre on ratkaisu kaikille sähkökirjatarpeillesi.

Calibrea käyttäen voit muun muassa lukea kirjoja tietokoneellasi, muokata kirjoja, saattaa kirjat muiden saataville verkkoon sisältöpalvelimen avulla, luetteloida kirjoja, noutaa kirjojen metadata automaattisesti, muuntaa kirjoja lukuisista eri tiedostomuodoista toisiin tiedostomuotoihin ja lähettää kirjoja lukulaitteisiin. Voit myös ladata uutisia ja julkaisuja e-kirjamuodossa yli tuhannelta eri uutis- ja aikakausilehtisivustolta.
calibre est la solution ultime pour tous vos besoins par rapport aux livres numériques

Vous pouvez utiliser calibre pour cataloguer vos livres, rapatrier des métadonnées les concernant, les convertir depuis et vers tous les formats de livre numérique existants, les envoyer à vos périphériques de lecture, lire les livres sur votre ordinateur, éditer les livres dans un éditeur spécialisé et même les rendre disponibles via votre réseau, avec le Serveur de contenu intégré. Vous pouvez également télécharger des actualités et des périodiques au format numérique depuis un millier de sites web d'actualités et de magazines différents.
calibre é a solución única para todas as súas necesidades de libros electrónicos.

Podes usar calibre para catalogar os teus libros, buscar metadatos para eles automaticamente, convertelos desde e para todos os distintos formatos de libros electrónicos, envialos aos teus dispositivos lectores de libros electrónicos, ler os libros no teu ordenador, editar os libros nun editor de libros electrónicos dedicado e incluso poñelos dispoñibles na rede co servidor de contido integrado. Tamén pode descargar noticias e publicacións periódicas en formato e-book desde máis de mil sitios web de noticias e revistas diferentes.
a calibre a tökéletes megoldás mindenre az e-könyvvel kapcsolatban.

A Calibre segítségével katalogizálhatja könyveit, automatikusan lekérheti a metaadatokat, konvertálhatja őket az összes különféle e-könyv formátumból és formátumba, elküldheti őket e-könyv olvasó eszközeire, elolvashatja a könyveket a számítógépén, szerkesztheti a könyveket egy dedikált e-könyvszerkesztőben, és akár a hálózaton keresztül is elérhetővé teheti őket a beépített tartalomkiszolgálóval. Több mint ezer különböző hír- és magazinoldalról tölthet le híreket és folyóiratokat e-könyv formátumban.
calibre è la soluzione unica per tutto ciò che riguarda gli e-book.

Puoi usare calibre per catalogare i tuoi libri, recuperare i loro metadati automaticamente, convertirli da e verso tutti i vari formati di e-book, inviarli ai tuoi dispositivi di lettura e-book, leggere i libri sul tuo computer, modificare i libri in un editor e-book dedicato e persino renderli disponibili in rete con il server dei contenuti integrato. Puoi anche scaricare notizie e periodici in formato e-book da oltre un migliaio di diversi siti di notizie e di riviste.
calibreは電子書籍のすべてのニーズに応えるワンストップソリューションです。
calibreは、本のカタログ化、本の書誌の自動取得、様々な電子書籍形式間での変換、電子書籍リーダデバイスへの送信、コンピュータ上での表示、洗練された電子書籍エディタによる編集、さらにはコンテンツサーバを使ってのネットワーク上での本の公開などを行うことができます。また、様々なニュースサイト、雑誌のサイトなどから、ニュースを電子書籍形式で定期的にダウンロードすることもできます。
calibre는 전자책 관련 모든 요구를 해결하는 원스톱 솔루션입니다.
calibre를 사용하면 책을 정리하고, 자동으로 메타데이터를 가져오고, 다양한 전자책 형식으로 변환하고, 전자책 리더 장치로 전송하고, 컴퓨터에서 읽고, 전용 전자책 편집기에서 편집하고, 내장 콘텐츠 서버로 네트워크를 통해 제공할 수도 있습니다. 또한 천 개가 넘는 뉴스 및 잡지 웹사이트에서 전자책 형식의 뉴스와 정기간행물을 다운로드할 수 있습니다.
calibre ir vienas pieturas risinājums visām Jūsu e-grāmatu vajadzībām.

Jūs varat izmantot calibre, lai katalogā iekļautu grāmatas, automātiski tās iegādātos, tās pārvērstu no un uz dažādiem e-grāmatu formātiem, nosūtītu tās uz jūsu e-grāmatu lasītāja ierīci, lasītu grāmatas jūsu datorā, labot grāmatas izvēlētajā e-grāmatu redaktorā un pat padarīt tās pieejamas visā tīklā ar iebūvēto satura serveri. Jūs varat arī lejupielādēt jaunumus un periodiskos izdevumus e-grāmatu formātā no vairāk nekā tūkstošiem dažādu ziņu un žurnālu vietnēm.
calibre is de complete oplossing voor al uw E-boek wensen.

U kunt calibre gebruiken om uw boeken te catalogiseren, automatisch metadata voor ze op te halen, ze van en naar alle verschillende e-boekformaten te converteren, ze naar uw e-reader te sturen, de boeken op uw computer te lezen, de boeken te wijzigen in een speciale e-boekbewerker en de boeken zelfs beschikbaar te stellen via het netwerk met de ingebouwde Content server. U kunt ook nieuws en tijdschriften downloaden in e-boekformaat van meer dan duizend verschillende nieuws en tijdschriften websites.
calibre to jedna odpowiedź na wszystkie twoje potrzeby związane z e-bookami.

Możesz użyć Calibre do katalogowania swoich książek, automatycznego pobierania dla nich metadanych, konwertowania ich do różnych formatów e-booków, wysyłania ich do czytników e-booków, czytania książek na komputerze, edytowania książek w dedykowany edytor e-booków, a nawet udostępniaj je w sieci za pomocą wbudowanego serwera treści. Możesz także pobierać wiadomości i czasopisma w formacie e-booków z ponad tysiąca różnych witryn z wiadomościami i magazynami.
O Calibre é a solução centralizada para todas as suas necessidades ligadas a livros digitais.

Pode usar o Calibre para catalogar os seus livros, obter metadados automaticamente, converter entre diversos formatos de livros digitais, enviar livros para dispositivos de leitura, ler os livros no seu computador, editar os livros num editor dedicado e ainda torná-los disponíveis numa rede através do servidor de conteúdos que já vem incorporado. Pode também descarregar notícias e jornais, em formato de livro digital, de milhares de sítios de jornais e revistas.
O calibre é a solução de uma parada a todas as suas necessidades de e-book.

Você pode usar o calibre para catalogar seus livros, buscar automaticamente metadados para eles, convertê-los de e para todos os vários formatos de e-books, enviá-los para os seus dispositivos de leitura de e-books, ler os livros no seu computador, editar os livros em um editor dedicado de e-books e até mesmo torná-los disponíveis através da rede com o servidor de conteúdo interno. Você também pode baixar notícias e periódicos em formato de e-book de milhares websites diferentes de notícias e revistas.
calibre - это комплексное решение для всех ваших нужд при работе с электронными книгами.

Вы можете использовать calibre для каталогизации своих книг, автоматически получать метаданные для них, конвертировать книги между форматами, отправлять их на читалки, читать книги на компьютере, редактировать книги в выделенном редакторе электронных книг и даже сделать их доступными по сети через встроенный контент-сервер. Вы также можете загружать новости и журналы с сайтов в формате электронных книг.
calibre är en samlad lösning för alla dina e-bokbehov.

Du kan använda calibre för att katalogisera dina böcker, hämta metadata för dem automatiskt, konvertera dem från och till alla de olika e-bokformat, skicka dem till dina e-bokläsenheter, läsa böcker på datorn, redigera böckerna i en dedikerad e-bokredigerare och även göra dem tillgängliga via nätverket med den inbyggda innehållsservern. Du kan också hämta nyheter och tidskrifter i e-bokformat från över tusen olika nyhets- och tidningswebbplatser.
உங்கள் மின் புத்தகத் தேவைகளுக்கு ஒரு நிறுத்த தீர்வு திறன்.

உங்கள் புத்தகங்களை பட்டியலிடவும், அவற்றுக்கான மெட்டாடேட்டாவைப் பெறவும், அவற்றை தானாக மாற்றவும், அவற்றை மாற்றவும், பல்வேறு மின் புத்தக வடிவங்களிலிருந்து மாற்றவும், அவற்றை உங்கள் மின் புத்தக வாசகர் சாதனங்களுக்கு அனுப்பவும், உங்கள் கணினியில் உள்ள புத்தகங்களைப் படிக்கவும், புத்தகங்களைத் திருத்தவும் நீங்கள் காலிபரைப் பயன்படுத்தலாம் a அர்ப்பணிக்கப்பட்ட மின் புத்தக எடிட்டர் மற்றும் உள்ளமைக்கப்பட்ட உள்ளடக்க சேவையகத்துடன் பிணையத்தில் கூட அவற்றைக் கிடைக்கச் செய்யுங்கள். ஆயிரம் வெவ்வேறு செய்திகள் மற்றும் செய்தித் தாள் வலைத்தளங்களிலிருந்து மின் புத்தக வடிவத்தில் செய்திகள் மற்றும் கால இடைவெளிகளையும் பதிவிறக்கம் செய்யலாம்.
Calibre tüm e-kitap ihtiyaçlarınız için bir çözümdür.

Calibre'yi kitaplarınızı kataloglamak, onlar için otomatik olarak üstveri getirmek, çeşitli e-kitap formatlarından ve bu formatlara dönüştürmek, e-kitap okuyucu cihazlarınıza göndermek, kitapları bilgisayarınızdan okumak, kitapları özel bir e-kitap düzenleyicide düzenlemek ve hatta yerleşik İçerik sunucusu ile ağ üzerinden kullanılabilir hale getirmek için kullanabilirsiniz. Ayrıca binin üzerinde farklı haber ve dergi sitesinden haber ve süreli yayınları e-kitap formatında indirebilirsiniz.
calibre — програма, за допомогою якої ви зможете зробити з вашою книгою усе, що потрібно.

Ви можете скористатися calibre для каталогізації ваших книг, автоматичного отримання метаданих щодо книг, перетворення даних книги у один з багатьох форматів електронних книжок, надсилання книг на пристрої для читання електронних книг, читання книг на вашому комп’ютері, редагування книг у спеціалізованому редакторі для електронних книг і навіть оприлюднення книг у мережі за допомогою вбудованого сервера. Крім того, ви зможете отримувати новини та періодичні видання у форматі електронної книги з понад тисячі різноманітних сайтів новин та журналів.
calibre是满足所有电子书需求的一站式解决方案。
你可以使用 calibre 对书籍进行编目、自动获取元数据、在各种电子书格式之间相互转换、将它们发送到电子书阅读器设备、在计算机上阅读书籍、在专用的电子书编辑器中编辑书籍，甚至通过内置的内容服务器使它们在网络上共享。你也可以从一千多个不同的新闻和杂志网站下载电子书格式的新闻和期刊。
Calibre 是滿足您所有電子書需求的一站式解決方案。
您可以使用 calibre 對圖書進行編目、自動取得中繼資料、將它們從各種電子書格式轉換為各種電子書格式、將它們傳送到電子書閱讀器裝置、在電腦上閱讀圖書、在專用的電子書編輯器中編輯圖書，甚至透過內建的內容伺服器使它們在網路上可取得。您也可以從一千多個不同的新聞和雜誌網站下載電子書格式的新聞和期刊。
New features:

ol.li: Allow generating book covers using AI with different cover styles such as romance, sci-fi, pulp fiction etc. (To use it select a book and click Edit metadata and then the "AI Generate" button. Note that you will have to configure an image generating AI provider the first time you use this feature.)
Edit book: File browser: When hovering the mouse over an image file show a floating preview of the image next to the file browser
Tags editor: have searching ignore accents (Closes tickets: 2164853)
AI: Add Anthropic and Grok backends for Claude and Grok models
AI: Remove GitHub backend as service has been discontinued (Closes tickets: 2163567)
Edit metadata dialog: Always scale up cover preview to fill available space while maintaining aspect ratio

description.p: Bug fixes:

ol.li: Content server: OPDS: Fix a regression that caused first line of comments to be missing (Closes tickets: 2165075)
Undo delete books: Show a progress bar when more than five books have to be undeleted (Closes tickets: 2164811)
Linux: Binary builds: Fix hyperlinks in labels not working on some Linux systems (Closes tickets: 2164584)
Get books: Fix a regression that broke show in store (Closes tickets: 2164586)
Fix cover images with empty EXIF records not showing on Kindle lockscreen (Closes tickets: 1943495)
Fix a regression in 9.11 that broke configuring the Folder device driver (Closes tickets: 2163674)
Google AI: Fix the checkbox to allow search grounding invisible in the config dialog (Closes tickets: 2163025)
Fix a regression in 9.11 that broke reading metadata from HTML files in builds of calibre with Python runtime assertions enabled
Edit book: Jump to class: Fix @charset rule causing jump to class to be off-by-one because it uses tiny css which ignores chaset rules while cssutils does not
FB2 Input: Only accept known FB2 namespaces to avoid arbitrary file write
Content server: Fix various arbitrary file write bugs for authenticated users
Content server: Fix remote code execution for authenticated users
Content server: Fix cross site scripting in legacy book details page
MOBI Output: Make palmdoc compression robust against crafted input

description.p: New features:
Bug fixes:

ol.li: PDF Output: Fix a regression in calibre 9 which caused links in PDF to scroll to a target location minus the top margin, thus ending up a few lines above the target
Content server: Fix an error when uploading a data file to a book with no existing data files (Closes tickets: 2162628)
Content server: Fix a regression in the previous release that broke searching in the builtin viewer (Closes tickets: 2162644)
Content server: Fix a regression in the previous release that caused the conversion options sections to be missing (Closes tickets: 2162647)
Book details panel: Fix a regression in the previous release that broke drag and drop of covers (Closes tickets: 2162711)
Windows: Fix a crash caused by some third party plugins trying to send notifications in non-GUI threads (Closes tickets: 2162935)
Bulk metadata dialog: Fix a regression in the previous release that caused the yes/no buttons to be hidden for Yes/No column edit controls (Closes tickets: 2162638)
Edit book: Compress Images: Fix error when converting GIF to JPEG on Windows
Linux: Preload html5-parser to avoid errors on systems that ship ancient libxml2 when converting to PDF

description.p: New news sources:

description.p: New features:

ol.li: macOS: Add sharing of books via AirDrop to the Connect/Share button
Content server: Add support for plugins that can add new endpoints to the server backend
Edit book: Compress images: Add an option to convert GIF images to JPEG/WebP
ToC Editor: Add a button to sort the entries in the Table of Contents (Closes tickets: 2161171)
Content server: OPDS: Add kind metadata to feed links (Closes tickets: 2161117)
Kobo driver: Add support for latest Tolino firmware

description.p: Bug fixes:

ol.li: E-book viewer: Fix an issue causing text area width to change when using section titles in header/footers and the text is too long to fit in the space (Closes tickets: 2160341)
When adding books via calibre.exe fix --with-library not working. Now calibre will switch to the specified library and only then add the book (Closes tickets: 2162073)
When evaluating recursive templates inherit python template policy
Fix inability to input more than ~30K characters in custom tag like columns (Closes tickets: 2161833)
Fix some menu separators not rendering on some systems with high res monitors
Content server: fix un-styled flash when transitioning between series/author views in dark mode
Content server: Prevent unauthenticated users from updating annotations
Edit metadata dialog: Fix right click menu->Remove format not working (Closes tickets: 2160467)
Edit book: fix typo in string format that broke convert PNG to JPEG function
Linux binaries: Preload libxml2 to ensure the correct version is loaded despite Qt WebEngine probing

ul.li: Emulates the Sega SG-1000, SC-3000, Master System, and Game Gear
Emulates the Sega MegaDrive/Genesis and its accessories the Sega Mega-CD/Sega-CD and the Sega 32X
Emulates the Sega Pico

description.p: Access your Home Assistant dashboard from a native companion UI, integrating better with your OS. Native features include:

ul.li: Icon in your App Grid, Applications Menu, Dash, Dock, etc.
Native header bar
Save and restore current view and size when closed and re-opened
Two-finger swipe and mouse button support to go back/forward between views
Cross-desktop light/dark style support (if supported by your Lovelace theme)

description.p: Butler is designed to make getting at your Home Assistant dashboard easier for kiosks, your laptop/desktop, or your Linux phone. It does not currently support companion app features from Android and iOS like location services, notifications, or exposing device sensors—if you’d like to add those features, please check out the website to contribute!
Other features include:

ul.li: Pinch-to-zoom
Set the scaling with Ctrl+Plus/Minus or Ctrl+0 to reset
Fullscreen from the menu, a keyboard shortcut, or a GSetting to better support kiosk use cases

description.p: Note WebRTC camera streams (i.e. used by some newer Nest cameras) are not currently supported.

component.summary: اطرح الأسئلة، واحصل على إجابات روحانية
Demandez, et obtenez des réponses psychiques
Fai domande e ottieni risposte psichiche
Få mystiske svar på spørsmålene dine
Pausatz de questions, obtenètz de responsa d’endevinaire
Faça perguntas e obtenha respostas psíquicas
Sorular sorun ve psişik cevaplar alın

description.p: أيحبك؟ أينبغي أن تتناول المعجنات في العشاء؟ أيوجد ما يسمى بالسؤال الغبي؟ اكتشف إجابات هذه الأسئلة والمزيد مع «المستبصر»، العرَّاف المستوحى من كرة الثمانية السحرية.

ul.li: اطرح سؤالًا، ثم افتح «المستبصر» لتحصل على إجابة.
ألست راضيًا؟ اسأل مجددًا، ثم اضغط على «اسأل مجددًا» للمحاولة مرة أخرى.
افعل ما تشاء بالإجابات، ولكن لا تطلق النار على الساعي!

description.p: Обича ли ви? Трябва ли да хапнете пица за вечеря? Има ли глупав въпрос? Открийте отговорите на тези и други въпроси с „Ясновидец“, вдъхновения от магическата топка гадател.

ul.li: Задайте въпрос, а след това отворете „Ясновидец“, за да получите отговор.
Не сте доволни? Попитайте отново, след което натиснете „Попитай отново“.
Правете с отговорите каквото искате - само не стреляйте по пратеника!

description.p: Does he love you? Should you have pizza for dinner? Is there such thing as a stupid question? Discover the answers to these questions and more with Clairvoyant, the magic 8-ball inspired fortune teller.

ul.li: Ask a question, then open Clairvoyant for an answer.
Not satisfied? Ask again, then hit "Ask Again" to try again.
Do what you'd like with the answers—just don't shoot the messenger!

description.p: Warning: it has been noted that “such a program can lead people away from God, as they are making an idol of an application and putting their faith into a virtual 8 ball.” Proceed at your own risk!
Miluje tě? Měl bys mít pizzu k večeři? Je něco jako stupidní otázka? Objevte odpovědi na tyto otázka a více s Clairvoyant, kouzelným 8-míčkem inspirovaným věštcem.

ul.li: Položte otázku, pak otevřte Clairvoyant pro odpověď.
Nespokojeni? Zeptejte se znova, pak stiskněte "Zeptat se Znova" aby jste se zeptali znova.
S odpovědí si dělejte si co chcete—jen nestřílejte na posla!

description.p: Elsker han dig? Skal du have pizza til aftensmad? Findes der faktisk dumme spørgsmål? Udforsk svarende til disse spørgsmål og meget mere med Clairvoyant, den magiske 8-ball inspireret spåkone.

ul.li: Stil et spørgsmål, derefter åben Clairvoyant for svar.
Ikke tilfreds? Sprøg igen, derefter tryk på "Spørg igen" for at prøve igen.
Gør hvad du har lyst til med svarende—bare ikk' skyd budbringeren!

description.p: Liebt er dich? Solltest du Pizza zum Abendessen esse? Gibt es blöde Fragen? Entdecke die Antworten auf diese Fragen und mehr mit Clairvoyant, der Magic 8 Ball inspirierte Wahrsager.

ul.li: Stelle eine Frage, öffne danach Clairvoyant für eine Antwort.
Nicht zufrieden? Frage noch einmal, dann klicke auf "Erneut Fragen", um es noch einmal zu versuchen.
Mache mit den Antworten was du willst—bestrafe nur den Überbringer der schlechten Nachrichten nicht!

description.p: Does he love you? Should you have pizza for dinner? Is there such thing as a stupid question? Discover the answers to these questions and more with Clairvoyant, the magic 8-ball inspired fortune teller.

ul.li: Ask a question, then open Clairvoyant for an answer.
Do what you'd like with the answers—just don't shoot the messenger!

description.p: Does he love you? Should you have pizza for dinner? Is there such thing as a stupid question? Discover the answers to these questions and more with Clairvoyant, the magic 8-ball inspired fortune teller.

ul.li: Ask a question, then open Clairvoyant for an answer.
Do what you'd like with the answers—just don't shoot the messenger!

description.p: Does he love you? Should you have pizza for dinner? Is there such thing as a stupid question? Discover the answers to these questions and more with Clairvoyant, the magic 8-ball inspired fortune teller.

ul.li: Ask a question, then open Clairvoyant for an answer.
Do what you'd like with the answers—just don't shoot the messenger!

description.p: ¿Me ama? ¿Debería de cenar pizza? ¿Existe algo cómo una pregunta estúpida? Descubre las respuestas a esas preguntas y más con Clairvoyant, el contestador mágico inspirado en la bola 8.

ul.li: Pregunta algo, después abre Clairvoyant para saber la respuesta.
¡Haz lo que quieras con las respuestas, pero no dispares al mensajero!

description.p: آیا او دوستتان دارد؟ آیا باید برای شام پیتزا بخورید؟ آیا چیزی به نام پرسش احمقانه وجود دارد؟ پاسخ این پرسش‌ها را با روشن‌بین، پیشگوی الهام‌گرفته‌شده از گوی جادویی ۸ کشف کنید.

ul.li: سوالی بپرسید، سپس برای پاسخ روشن‌بین را باز کنید.
خشنودتان نکرد؟ دوباره بپرسید، سپس برای تلاش دوباره روی «دوباره بپرس» کلیک کنید.
با پاسخ‌ها هر کاری که می‌خواهید بکنید—فقط پیام‌رسان را سرزنش نکنید!

description.p: Est-ce qu’il t’aime ? Devrais-tu manger de la pizza pour le dîner ? Existe-t-il une question stupide ? Découvrez les réponses à ces questions et plus encore avec Clairvoyant, diseur de bonne aventure inspiré de la boule 8 magique.

ul.li: Posez-vous une question, puis ouvrez Clairvoyant pour une réponse.
Vous n’êtes pas satisfait ? Reposez la question, puis cliquez sur « Demander à nouveau » pour réessayer.
Faites ce que vous voulez avec les réponses, mais ne tirez pas sur le messager !

description.p: Je li te voli? Da li večeras jesti pizzu? Postoji li glupo pitanje? Otkrij odgovore na ova pitanja i još mnogo toga pomoću aplikacije Clairvoyant, magičnog pretkazivanja inspirirano na kugli 8.

ul.li: Postavite pitanje, zatim otvorite Clairvoyant za odgovor.
Niste zadovoljni? Pitajte ponovo, a zatim pritisnite „Pitaj ponovo“ za ponovni pokušaj.
Učinite što želite s odgovorima – samo nemojte ubiti glasonošu!

description.p: Lui ti ama? Dovresti mangiare la pizza per cena? Esistono domande stupide? Scopri le risposte a queste e altre domande con Clairvoyant, l'indovino ispirato alla palla 8 magica.

ul.li: Fai una domanda, quindi apri Clairvoyant per una risposta.
Non soddisfatto? Chiedi di nuovo, quindi premi «Chiedi ancora» per riprovare.
Faʼ quello che vuoi con le risposte, ma ricorda, ambasciator non porta pena!

description.p: Lurer du på om din store kjærlighet elsker deg tilbake? Eller om du bør ha pizza til middag? Finnes det i det hele tatt dumme spørsmål? Finn svar på alt dette og mer med Clairvoyant, din egen virtuelle krystallkule.

ul.li: Still et spørsmål, og åpne Clairvoyant for å få svar.
Misfornøyd med svaret? Bare spør på nytt.
Gjør hva du vil med det Clairvoyant forteller deg.

description.p: Houdt hij van me? Moet ik wel pizza halen als avondeten? Bestaat er zoiets als een ‘domme vraag’? Vind de antwoorden op deze vragen met Clairvoyant, de door de magische 8-ball geïnspireerde waarzegger.

ul.li: Stel een vraag en open Clairvoyant om een antwoord te krijgen.
Ontevreden? Vraag het opnieuw en klik op ‘Opnieuw vragen’.
Interpreteer de antwoorden op uw eigen manier, maar spreek mij er niet op aan!

description.p: Czy on cię kocha? Czy powinieneś zjeść pizzę na obiad? Czy istniejecoś takiego, jak głupie pytanie? Odkryj odpowiedzi na te, i nie tylko te,pytania dzięki Jasnowidzowi, aplikacji wzorowanej na magicznej kuli nr 8.

ul.li: Zadaj pytanie i uruchom Jasnowidza, żeby dostać odpowiedź.
Z odpowiedziami zrób, co zechcesz – tylko nie strzelaj do posłańca!

description.p: Será que ele a ama? Deve fazer pizza para o jantar? Existe tal coisa como uma pergunta estúpida? Descubra as respostas a estas perguntas e mais com o Clairvoyant, a bola magica 8 inspirada pelo vidente.

ul.li: Faça uma pergunta, depois abra o Clairvoyant para obter uma resposta.
Faça o que quiser com as respostas—apenas não dispare sobre o mensageiro!

description.p: Será que ele te ama? Você deveria jantar pizza? Existe alguma pergunta que seja idiota? Descubra as respostas para essas e outras perguntas com Clarividente, o vidente inspirado na Bola 8 Mágica.

ul.li: Faça uma pergunta e abra o Clarividente para obter a resposta.
Não foi suficiente? Pergunte novamente e depois clique em "Perguntar novamente" para tentar mais uma vez.
Faça o que quiser com as respostas, apenas não atire no mensageiro!

description.p: Любит ли он тебя? Стоит ли вам заказать пиццу на ужин? Существует ли такая вещь, как глупый вопрос? Узнайте ответы на эти и многие другие вопросы вместе с «Провидцем», вдохновленным «Magic 8 ball».

ul.li: Задайте вопрос, затем откройте «Провидец» для получения ответа.
Не удовлетворены? Задайте вопрос ещё раз, затем нажмите «Спросить ещё раз».
Делайте с ответами всё, что хотите — только не стреляйте в посланника!

description.p: Seni seviyor mu? Akşam yemeğinde pizza yemeli misiniz? Aptalca soru diye bir şey var mı? Sihirli 8 topundan ilham alan falcı Clairvoyant ile bu soruların ve daha fazlasının cevaplarını keşfedin.

ul.li: Bir soru sorun, ardından cevap için Clairvoyant'ı açın.
Tatmin edici değil? Tekrar sorun ve tekrar denemek için "Tekrar Sor" düğmesine basın.
Cevaplarla ne isterseniz yapın - sadece haberciyi vurmayın!

description.p: Чи кохає він вас? Чи варто замовити піцу на вечерю? Чи існують дурні запитання? На ці та інші питання ви можете отримати відповідь у Ясновидця, додатку заснованого на іграшці-ясновидці "Magic 8 ball".

ul.li: Поставте питання і тоді відкрийте Ясновидець, щоб отримати відповідь.
Не задоволені? Спитайте ще раз і натисніть "Спитати ще раз", щоб спробувати ще раз.
Робить з цими відповідями що бажаєте - головне не пристрельте відправника!

description.p: 他喜歡你嗎？晚餐要吃滷肉飯嗎有問題的是人還是問題本身？Clairvoyant 算命師即將幫你解答你的問題

ul.li: 先想好一個問題，然後開啟 Clairvoyant 取得答案
不滿意得到的答案嗎？你可以按"再問一次"。
你可以不相信你得到的答案，但請不要罵這位可憐的算命師

description.p: Analyze any display. Input a few simple details and figure out the aspect ratio, DPI, and other details of a particular display. Great for deciding which laptop or external monitor to purchase, and if it would be considered HiDPI.
Lots of handy features:

ul.li: Find out if a display is a good choice based on its size and resolution
Get advice about different densities
Learn the logical resolution

component.name: Logisim
component.summary: Logisim a graphical tool for desigining and simulating logic circuits

description.p: Logisim is an educational tool for designing and simulating digital logic circuits. With its simple toolbar interface and simulation of circuits as you build them, it is simple enough to facilitate learning the most basic concepts related to logic circuits. With the capacity to build larger circuits from smaller subcircuits, and to draw bundles of wires with a single mouse drag, Logisim can be used (and is used) to design and simulate entire CPUs for educational purposes.

Logisim is used by students at colleges and universities around the world in many types of classes, ranging from a brief unit on logic in general-education computer science surveys, to computer organization courses, to full-semester courses on computer architecture.

description.p: If you’ve ever put together end credits for a film, you know they are laborious to assemble and a pain to get right. Altering the layout, font size, or spacing after the fact is incredibly time-consuming. And don’t even think about hitting an exact runtime requirement while circumnavigating the shimmer trap.

But there is a better way: Cinecred, a free and open source program to create credits without the pain. Cinecred reads your credits data from an Excel, LibreOffice, Google, or Nextcloud spreadsheet, and then lets you interactively arrange and style the credits in any way you like. There’s a default template that gets you off the ground quickly, but everything can be customized down to the pixel. Use your own fonts or insert logos, pictures, or even videos. And once you’re done, check the scroll in the integrated player, before exporting it in a plethora of video and image sequence formats.

Pokud jste někdy dávali dohromady závěrečné titulky k filmu, tak jistě víte, jak otravně pracné jsou dát dohromady. Předělávat rozmístění, velikosti písma, nebo odsazení je neskutečně zdlouhavá piplačka. A zapomeňte, že se trefíte na požadovanou délku, aniž by se vám neškubaly, jako by měly třesavku.

Existuje však lepší způsob: Cinecred - svobodný a otevřený software k tvorbě závěrečných titulků bezbolestně. Cinecred čte data vašich titulků z tabulky Excelu, LibreOffice, Google, nebo Nextcloud, a poté vám umožní si interaktivně titulky nastylovat, jakkoliv se vám zlíbí. Součástí je výchozí šablona se kterou dosáhnete rychlého výsledku, vše si ale lze upravit podle svého, až na úrovni pixelů. Používejte vlastní fonty, vkládejte loga, obrázky, či videa. A až budete hotoví, prohléhněte si svou práci v integrovaném přehrávači, než je exportujete do širokého množství obrázkových a video formátů.

Wenn Sie schon einmal einen Filmabspann erstellt haben, wissen Sie, wie mühsam und schwierig das ist. Nachträglich das Layout, die Schriftgröße oder die Abstände zu ändern ist unglaublich zeitaufwendig. Und denken Sie nicht einmal daran, eine genaue Laufzeitvorgabe einzuhalten und dabei die Schimmerfalle zu umschiffen.

Doch es gibt einen besseren Weg: Cinecred, ein freies und quelloffenes Programm zum schmerzfreien Erstellen von Abspännen. Cinecred liest die Abspanndaten aus einer Excel-, LibreOffice-, Google- oder Nextcloud-Tabelle ein, und lässt Sie den Abspann dann interaktiv arrangieren und gestalten wie Sie möchten. Dank einer Standardvorlage legen Sie sofort los, doch jedes Detail lässt sich anpassen. Nutzen Sie Ihre eigenen Schriftarten oder fügen Sie Logos, Bilder oder gar Videos ein. Und wenn Sie fertig sind, kontrollieren Sie den Abspann im integrierten Player, bevor Sie ihn in einer Vielzahl von Video- und Einzelbildsequenzformaten exportieren.

Y ni siquiera pienses en cumplir con un requisito de tiempo exacto mientras circunnavegas la trampa de brillo.

Pero hay una forma mejor: Cinecred, un programa gratuito y de código abierto para crear créditos sin complicaciones. Hay una plantilla predeterminada que te permite despegar rápidamente, pero se puede personalizar todo a nivel de pixel. Utiliza tus propias fuentes o añade logotipos, imágenes e incluso vídeos. Y una vez que lo hayas hecho, comprueba el desplazamiento en el reproductor integrado, antes de exportarlo en multitud de formatos de secuencias de vídeo e imágenes.

Men det finnes en bedre måte: Cinecred, et fritt og åpent program for å lage rulletekster uten slit. Cinecred leser kredittdataene dine fra et Excel-, LibreOffice- eller Google-regneark og lar deg interaktivt arrangere og utforme rulletekstene akkurat slik du ønsker. Det følger med en standardmal som får deg raskt i gang, men alt kan egendefineres ned til den enkelte piksel. Bruk dine egne fonter eller sett inn logoer, bilder - til og med videoer. Når du er ferdig, kan du forhåndsvise rulleteksten i den integrerte avspilleren før du eksporterer den til et bredt utvalg av video- og bildeformater.

Fazer ajustes no layout, no tamanho da fonte ou no espaçamento depois que tudo está pronto pode consumir horas preciosas. E sem falar da dificuldade de alcançar a duração exata sem gerar o temido efeito de cintilação.

Mas existe um caminho melhor: Cinecred, um programa gratuito e de código aberto para criar créditos de forma simples e sem dor de cabeça. O Cinecred lê os dados da sua planilha — seja do Excel, LibreOffice ou Google Sheets — e permite que você organize e estilize os créditos de forma interativa, como quiser. Com o modelo padrão, você já começa com rapidez — e pode ajustar cada detalhe conforme suas necessidades. É possível usar suas próprias fontes, adicionar logotipos, imagens e até vídeos. Quando tudo estiver pronto, basta visualizar o rolo de créditos no player integrado e, em seguida, exportar nos mais diversos formatos de vídeo ou sequência de imagens.

Если вы когда-либо составляли финальные титры для фильма, вы знаете, насколько это трудоёмкий процесс и как сложно сделать всё правильно. Изменение макета, размера шрифта или интервалов после создания — невероятно долгая и утомительная задача. А уж о точном соблюдении временных требований и обходе ловушек с мерцанием и говорить нечего.

Но есть более простой способ: Cinecred — бесплатная программа с открытым исходным кодом для создания титров без головной боли. Cinecred считывает данные для титров из Excel, LibreOffice, Google и Nextcloud Таблиц, а затем позволяет интерактивно располагать и оформлять титры и их стиль так, как вам нравится. Есть стандартный шаблон для быстрого старта, но всё можно настроить до мелочей — вплоть до пикселя. Используйте свои шрифты, вставляйте логотипы, картинки или даже видео. А когда всё будет готово, проверьте прокрутку в интегрированном плеере, прежде чем экспортировать результат в различных видео и графических форматах.

Якщо ви колись збирали разом кінцеві титри для фільму, то ви напевно знаєте, що це вимагає багато зусиль зібрати їх до купи, та викликає великі труднощі зробити це правильно. Зміна шару, розміру шрифту або додавання пробілів, фактично, це забирає дуже багато часу. І навіть не думайте, що зможете зразу точнісінько вкластися у вимоги по тривалості коли будете ходити по колу, навколо пастки мерехтіння.

Але є кращий шлях: Cinecred, безкоштовна та з відкритим кодом програма, щоб створювати титри без великих зусиль. Cinecred вичитує ваші дані по титрам з Excel, LibreOffice, Google або Nextcloud електронних таблиць, і потім дозволяє вам інтерактивно виставляти та стилізувати титри в будь-який спосіб який вам до вподоби. В наявності є стандартний шаблон який надасть вам швидкого старту, але ви самі можете налаштувати все під себе, до самого пікселю. Використовуйте свої шрифти або вставляйте лого, зображення, або навіть відео. І коли ви вже все зробили, перевірте прокручування титрів в інтегрованому плеєрі, перед тим як експортувати їх в надмірну кількість відео форматів та формати послідовності зображень.

Webots provides a complete development environment to model, program, and simulate robots, vehicles, and mechanical systems. It is a beginner friendly software that is meant to introduce newcomers to the world of robotics.

Webots was originally designed at EPFL in 1996 as a research tool for mobile robotics. In 1998, it began being developed and commercialized by Cyberbotics. In December 2018, Webots was open sourced. Since then, Cyberbotics continues to develop Webots thanks to paid customer support, training, and consulting for industry and academic research projects.

component.name: GPU Screen Recorder
component.summary: A shadowplay-like screen recorder for Linux. The fastest screen recorder for Linux

description.p: This is a screen recorder that has minimal impact on system performance by recording a monitor using the GPU only, similar to shadowplay on windows. This is the fastest screen recording tool for Linux. This screen recorder works on X11 and Wayland on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA.
This screen recorder can be used for recording your desktop offline, for live streaming and for nvidia-like instant replay, where only the last few minutes are saved.
This flatpak is designed to support hardware video encoding with both old and new GPUs.
Supported video codecs:

ul.li: H264 (default)
HEVC (Optionally with HDR)
AV1 (Optionally with HDR)
VP8
VP9

ul.li: Opus (default)

ul.li: JPEG
PNG

description.p: At the moment the program comes with two different UIs. A gtk based one and a new experimental ShadowPlay-like fullscreen overlay UI. The gtk based UI will be removed in the future. You can switch to the new UI by clicking on "Try out the new UI" and then after that is done press Left Alt+Z to open/close it.

Videos are in variable framerate format by default. Use MPV to play such videos, otherwise you might experience stuttering in the video if you are using a buggy video player. Alternatively change framerate mode to constant framerate.
For more information visit the GPU Screen Recorder homepage.

If you use the new UI and also keyboard remapping software such as keyd then make sure you make the keyboard remapping software ignores "gsr-ui virtual keyboard" (dec0:5eba device id), otherwise you may be unable to use your keyboard. You can press (left) ctrl+shift+alt+esc to close gpu screen recorder and remove it from system startup if this happens. You should also change hotkeys option in gpu screen recorder to only grab virtual devices when using keyboard remapping software.
GPU Screen Recorder flatpak can install files in $HOME/.local/share/gpu-screen-recorder. If you want to uninstall GPU Screen Recorder then you will have to remove this directory manually.
If you tried out the new UI then an xdg autostart desktop entry was added to ~/.config/autostart/gpu-screen-recorder-ui.desktop.
If you want to uninstall GPU Screen Recorder then you will have to remove that file and ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gpu-screen-recorder@dec05eba.com/ as well (if you use GNOME).

description.p: Vermouth is a KDE-first game and application launcher. Run native Linux apps and games, Windows titles through Proton or Wine, and retro games via your RomM library with RetroArch - all from one place.

This release adds an Automatic Setup button and an Install a Game button to the welcome screen, unifies the view mode button between the pinned and unpinned sidebar, fixes a power-loss issue that could wipe out your game list, and fixes fetching RomM ROM files.

This release adds a live game log window, an optional scroll bar for the game grids, keeps the grid scroll position when hiding a game, and makes the default Proton always follow the one chosen in settings.

This release adds a last played date stamp and sort option, Auto HDR (toggle HDR automatically when launching and closing games), a fix for hidden apps unhiding themselves when edited, a fix for the RomM platform filter dropdown overlapping text, and reorganizes the GOG cache into the Vermouth data folder.
This release fixes some issues with Battle.net and other installed launchers under Flatpak, and adds a missing KDE status bar permission.
A feature-rich user backup program that allows you to backup your documents on a one-off or recurring scheduled basis.

component.name: RustDiff
component.summary: Comparador semántico de JSON y XML

description.p: RustDiff is a desktop application that compares two JSON or XML documents and highlights the differences in a clear, visual way. It is written in Rust and built on top of GTK4 and Libadwaita, so it feels native on the GNOME desktop.
Main features:

ul.li: Semantic diff for JSON (key by key) and XML (nodes, attributes and text).
Split editor with syntax highlighting and automatic pretty-print.
Inline and full-line highlighting for added, removed and changed items.
Filterable table of differences, clickable to jump to the exact location.
Export to plain text or styled HTML.
Session history backed by SQLite with per-entry and bulk deletion.
Ctrl + mouse wheel zoom on both editors, dark mode follows the system.

screenshot.caption: Comparing two JSON documents with inline highlights

description.p: A tidier header bar and a collapsible differences panel.

ul.li: The differences panel can now be hidden and brought back with a header bar button or Ctrl+D, giving the editors the full window height. Opening the graph view hides it automatically and closing the graph restores it.
Secondary header bar actions (differences, graph, history, format) are now icon buttons with tooltips and accessible labels, so the header stays compact on narrow windows.
Fixed symbolic icons that rendered as outlines invisible on dark themes: the bundled fallbacks are now fill-based, which is what GTK recolors.
Every icon the app uses now ships a bundled fallback, so no packaging channel can show a broken-image placeholder when the desktop icon theme lacks a name.
The Debian/APT package now ships the bundled SQL language definition, restoring SQL syntax highlighting for .deb installs.

description.p: Fixes broken icons in the graph view.

ul.li: The graph view toggle, its empty state and the "zoom to fit" button could show up as a generic broken-image icon on themes that don't ship network-workgroup-symbolic or zoom-fit-best-symbolic (notably the Homebrew Adwaita bundled into the macOS build). RustDiff now ships its own fallback icons for both names.
Documented that the .deb/APT packages require Ubuntu 24.04+ or an equivalent recent Debian (libadwaita >= 1.5, GTK4 >= 4.12); older systems should use the Flatpak package instead.

description.p: Fixes the macOS installer.

ul.li: Fixed a packaging bug that made the macOS DMG/Homebrew cask crash on launch with "Library not loaded: @rpath/libsharpyuv.0.dylib". The 0.3.1 macOS build was affected; other channels (Linux, Flathub, APT, crates.io) were not.

description.p: Maintenance release.

ul.li: Fixed a clippy lint failure in the history sidebar that was blocking CI.

description.p: DingTalk is an intelligent working platform created by Alibaba Group to support tens of millions of enterprises to achieve higher working efficiency with the new digitalized technique.
钉钉是阿里巴巴集团打造的企业级智能移动办公平台，是AI时代的全新工作方式。钉钉整合了AI助理、IM即时沟通、钉钉文档、多维表、视频会议、企业邮箱、Teambition、OA审批、智能人事、考勤等功能。
Discord is a free all in one messaging, voice, and video client thats available on your computer and phone.

Whether you’re part of a school club, gaming group, worldwide art community, or just a handful of friends that want to spend time together, Discord makes it easy to talk every day and hang out more often.

ul.li: Talk to your friends with messaging, voice, and video in a "Direct Message" (1 other person), group chat (up to 10 people), or a multi-channel server (practically infinite maximum members).
Discord servers are organized into topic-based channels where you can collaborate, share, and just talk about your day without clogging up a group chat.
Grab a seat in a voice channel when you’re free. Friends in your server can see you’re around and instantly pop in to talk without having to call.
Get a community of any size running with moderation tools and custom member access. Give members special powers, set up private channels, and more.
Low-latency voice and video feels like you’re in the same room. Wave hello over video, watch friends stream their games, or gather up and have a drawing session with screen share.
Available on Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and your web browser.

description.p: Discord is written in Javascript, React, Elixir, and Rust. The desktop application uses the electron framework.

The flatpak version runs in a sandbox to provide better safety and privacy for users. However, this sandboxing prevents the following features from working out of the box: Game Activity, Unrestricted File Access, Rich Presence. Check the README in the Github repo for details.
Discord — бесплатный клиент для переписки, голосового и видеообщения, доступный и на компьютере, и на телефоне.
Школьный кружок, игровое комьюнити, международное сообщество художников или просто компания друзей, которым хочется быть вместе, — с Discord легко общаться каждый день и чаще проводить время сообща.

ul.li: Общайтесь с друзьями текстом, голосом и по видео — в личных сообщениях (один собеседник), групповом чате (до 10 человек) или на сервере с множеством каналов (число участников практически не ограничено).
Серверы Discord разделены на тематические каналы: в них можно работать сообща, делиться находками и просто рассказывать, как прошёл день, не засоряя общий чат.
Загляните в голосовой канал, когда освободитесь. Друзья на сервере увидят, что вы на месте, и присоединятся к разговору сразу — без всяких звонков.
Развивайте сообщество любого размера: к вашим услугам инструменты модерации и гибкая настройка доступа. Выдавайте участникам особые права, создавайте закрытые каналы и не только.

Голос и видео почти без задержек — ощущение, будто вы в одной комнате. Помашите друг другу по видеосвязи, посмотрите, как друзья стримят свои игры, или соберитесь порисовать вместе, включив демонстрацию экрана.
Работает на Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android и прямо в браузере.

description.p: Discord написан на JavaScript, React, Elixir и Rust. Настольное приложение построено на фреймворке Electron.

Версия для Flatpak работает в песочнице — так безопаснее и лучше для приватности. Но из-за изоляции некоторые возможности не работают сразу после установки: игровая активность (Game Activity), неограниченный доступ к файлам и Rich Presence. Подробности — в файле README в репозитории на GitHub.

component.name: DIY Layout Creator
component.summary: Circuit layout design tool supporting PCB, vero-board, point-to-point, perf-board and guitar wiring diagrams

description.p: DIY Layout Creator (DIYLC in short) is a powerful, but simple to use and intuitive tool for visualizing electronic circuit schematic and layout diagrams. It provides a simple WYSIWYG interface and supports designing PCB, vero-board, point-to-point, perf-board and guitar wiring diagrams as well as circuit schematics quickly and without the steep learning curve.
In addition to drawing, the projects can be shared with other users through the integrated 'Cloud' feature. Guitar wiring diagrams can be analyzed and debugged.
DIYLC is geared towards DIY hobby enthusiasts and is developed by an enthusiast with the help of the large community of DIY builders.

ul.li: [Improvement] Upgraded JRE version of Mac builds to Themurin 17 and switched OpenGL to Metal rendering engine for improved performance
[Bug Fix] Choosing "Print" option from the menu starts printing immediately before choosing printing preferences
[New Feature] Buzzer component and symbol added (thanks M0JXD)
[New Feature] Resistor symbol now has two draw standards - ANSI and IEC (thanks M0JXD)
[Improvement] Fixed run.sh application starter for Linux and Apple OSX with M1/M2 processors when using Java 17 or newer
[Improvement] When editing Label components, default focus to the text editor
[Bug Fix] Unable to move selected components if one of them is close to being reduced to a point
[Bug Fix] Toroidal Inductor hangs the application if it doesn't have inductance value set
[New Feature] 'Proto Board 780 Holes' added with two variations (sponsored by Pete Olivier)
[Improvement] Ability to rotate (almost) all components using keyboard shortcuts and 'Transform Selection' menu
[New Feature] Title Block added as one of factory building blocks (was missing in 4.35 by mistake)
[New Feature] Configurable max switch combination count for circuit analysis (using org.diylc.maxSwitchCombinations argument)
[Improvement] Added resilience to the code that saves the configuration file to avoid it getting corrupted
[Improvement] When backing up the configuration file, append the current timestamp at the end instead of a '~'
[Improvement] Improve the format of timestamp in file backups
[Bug Fix] General application slowness when Inductor component is added to the drawing
[Bug Fix] Lever switch orientation not loaded correctly from files created prior to version 4.35

description.p: Dave Gnukem is a retro-style 2D scrolling platform shooter similar to, and inspired by, Duke Nukem 1 (~1991). While the original Duke Nukem 1 had 16-color EGA 320x200 graphics; the aim here is 'similar but different' gameplay and 'look and feel'. It is kind of a parody of the original. Please note it is not a 'clone', and not a 're-make'.
City-building simulation based on the source release of SimCity by originally developed by Maxis and published by Electronic Arts in 1989.
DOSBox is a DOS-emulator using SDL for easy portability to different platforms. It has already been ported to several different platforms, such as Windows, BeOS, Linux, Mac OS X.
DOSBox emulates a 286/386 realmode CPU, Directory FileSystem/XMS/EMS, a SoundBlaster card for excellent sound compatibility with older games.
You can "re-live" the good old days with the help of DOSBox, it can run plenty of the old classics that don't run on your new computer!

component.name: DOSBox-X
component.summary: x86/DOS emulator with sound and graphics

description.p: DOSBox-X is an open-source DOS emulator for running DOS games and applications. DOS-based Windows such as Windows 3.x and Windows 9x are officially supported. Compared to DOSBox, DOSBox-X is much more flexible and provides more features.

DOSBox-X emulates a PC necessary for running many DOS games and applications that simply cannot be run on modern PCs and operating systems, similar to DOSBox. However, while the main focus of DOSBox is for running DOS games, DOSBox-X goes much further than this. Started as a fork of the DOSBox project, it retains compatibility with the wide base of DOS games and DOS gaming DOSBox was designed for. But it is also a platform for running DOS applications, including emulating the environments to run Windows 3.x, 9x and ME and software written for those versions of Windows. By adding official support for Windows 95, 98, and ME emulation and acceleration, we hope that those old Windows games and applications could be enjoyed or used once more. Moreover, DOSBox-X adds support for emulating the NEC PC-98 such that you can also play PC-98 games with it.
DOSBox-X emulates a legacy IBM PC and DOS environment, and has many emulation options which you can find documented on the DOSBox-X website.

screenshot.caption: Windows 3.11 for Workgroups as Guest OS

component.name: Euterpe
component.summary: Audio player for the Euterpe media server

description.p: Mobile and desktop player for the self-hosted Euterpe streaming server. You need an access to an Euterpe server running somewhere in order for this program to be useful. You could try it out with the demo Euterpe server, accessible at the project's website.
These are some of the features of this player:

ul.li: Extremely light resource usage and fast. Excellent for constrained mobile devices such as phones and laptops.
Accessing Euterpe server with or without authentication.
Playing albums or a single tracks.
Searching the database for music.
Browsing by albums, artists and songs based on their tag metadata.
Manipulating playlists which are stored on the Euterpe server.
Mobile first but convergent. It works on both mobile and desktop Linux.

screenshot.caption: Different screens of the mobile program when viewed on mobile display
The album browser screen shown on the left pane
The artist browser screen show to the left
The search screen in its desktop variant
The login screen show in its mobile variant
The search screen in its mobile variant
The browse artist screen in its mobile variant
The playing queue opened on a mobile phone

description.p: This version improves the "Home" and "Browse" screens. The aim is for less wasted space in both of them. The "Browse" screen now includes a lot of more options.
Additionally, the artwork show in the main player area is now much bigger and kept behind the player controls.
Another version with small improvements.

ul.li: Fixed the automatic scrolling to the currently playing song in the play queue.
Reduce CPU usage from UI widgets which are not currently visible.

description.p: This version comes with few small improvements.

ul.li: Switch to using the version 3 of Libsoup. This makes it easier install the player on more modern desktop environments and runtimes.
Build a small buffer of data while streaming. This may help with spotty networks.
Improve the stability of the Gstreamer pipeline.

description.p: This version comes with few new features and some bug fixes.

ul.li: Browsing is enhanced with the ability to order by the browsed items in different ways. A quick buttons for going to the first or last page are added too.
It is now possible to browse the songs directly.
Songs' bitrate is now displayed on their widgets.

The player's state is now saved better on shutdown, restart or any different kind of request through the desktop environment such as logging out. Previously it was possible for the player to exit without saving its state. So the current playlist, play position and window position could've been lost. This should no longer be the case.

The play could now manage playlists stored on the server. The only notable missing feature here is that songs in a playlist cannot be reordered yet. Once I figure the GTK's drag-and-drop APIs this will be improved.

component.name: DSView
component.summary: An open source multi-function instrument for everyone

description.p: DSView is a GUI program for supporting various instruments from DreamSourceLab, including logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, etc. DSView is based on the sigrok project.

The sigrok project aims at creating a portable, cross-platform, Free/Libre/Open-Source signal analysis software suite that supports various device types (such as logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, multimeters, and more).
It is necessary to add the following line to the /etc/udev/rules.d/60-dreamsourcelab.rules file:
SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTRS{idVendor}=="2a0e", MODE="0666"

component.name: Bazecor
component.summary: Configurator for Dygma Raise and Defy keyboards

description.p: Bazecor is the graphical configurator for the Dygma Raise and Defy keyboards. While still heavily under development, it's at a stage where it is already usable.

The primary purpose of the application is to allow one to configure their keyboard without having to compile or flash firmware, by storing the configuration on the keyboard itself, in EEPROM. There are no external tools required, just Bazecor itself.

Macro Editor: Create, manage, and backup macros.
Colormap Editor: Customize per-key and underglow LED lighting.
Firmware Upgrade: Update keyboard firmware directly from the app.

component.name: Merkato
component.summary: A modern financial market tracker for GNOME

description.p: Merkato is a modern and intuitive financial market tracker designed for the GNOME desktop. Built with GTK4 and Libadwaita, it provides a native and elegant interface for monitoring stocks, indices, currencies, and cryptocurrencies in real-time using Yahoo Finance data.

The application offers both a traditional list view and an interactive heatmap view, allowing users to visualize market performance in multiple ways. Stocks are automatically categorized into sectors such as Technology, Healthcare, Energy, Financial Services, and more. Merkato also features persistent watchlists, automatic refresh, sorting options, and support for 27 languages.
Merkato is fully open source and built with performance and simplicity in mind, following GNOME's Human Interface Guidelines to deliver a clean, consistent, and distraction-free user experience.
Bug fixes

Enter the world of Aesop’s fables like never before! Interactive stories where you can customize characters, texts and sounds, hacking into its code in this absorbing and educational app.

Pop open the magical pages that offer a new approach to interacting with the beloved Aesop’s fables! Read and touch these time honored stories and then hack the pages to make them your own. The art, sounds and text can all be hacked, creating your unique fables you can share with others.

component.summary: An addictive crossy roads game with a twist

description.p: Do you have what it takes to cross these treacherous roads? You must dodge arrows, saws, and fire balls and not get squashed! Choose from eight different animals to cross these perilous roads. The key is survival to amass lots of loot and once you master the roads, hack your animal's AI and go farther than ever before!

Test your aerial maneuvers to be the best pilot in the skies. Blast enemy airplanes and avoid rapid fire while flying. Play Math Mode to outwit your enemies using your quick number and computational skills.

component.summary: Hack your way through this side-scrolling action adventure shooting game

description.p: You've landed on a mysterious planet with one mission; find the secret map to locate the hidden bunker. Can you find it? Hack the world to cross perilous lands and the obstacles within. Play to find out if can outsmart the passage.

component.name: Tank Warriors
component.summary: Program an AI to beat the enemy

description.p: Driving, shooting, explosions, and programming—all in one game! Take charge of your own personal tank to battle your way through multilevel arenas, defeating the enemy and completing objectives. Upgrade your tanks to be faster, tougher, and more powerful than your opponents. Hack your tank’s AI to outsmart the enemy’s tank to become reigning champion! Build your tank fleet, with real code… can you outsmart your own AI?
Level up your coding skills by learning and practicing functions, parameters, syntax, and more.

Players must use commands and keywords to create AI programs for their tanks. Each command/keyword has different requirements and will need either a conditional, a parameter, or nothing. The keywords expect players to guess their purpose and experiment; for example, turnTank is a function that requires a parameter, so it must need a turn angle to be given as a parameter. During battles, players can edit their tank’s code and view enemy’s AI, and the tank’s current line of code shows on the bottom of the screen to keep track. Your tank starts with a green ring of health that becomes lower and redder as the tank gets hit by bullets; in player-controlled mode, be sure to collect heart balloons to heal when your ring is low and red. In AI mode, be sure to program your tank with commands that move it out of enemy range.

screenshot.caption: Customize your tank’s colors, name, and stickers

description.p: Do not judge a book by its cover or lack of color! This time, you get to decide what color this world should be. Dive into the magical world of CSS and hack the world into a unique burst of color and light revealing hidden objects and clues. Learn basic CSS techniques used to color and set attributes to the 3D objects in this unique town. Want to paint the rest of the town? Well, get through the house first, and you might just get to leave through the front door.

description.p: Unreal Tournament 2004 is a multiplayer first person shooter that combines the kill-or-be-killed experience of gladiatorial combat with cutting-edge technology. Ten game modes provide even the most hardcore gamer with palm-sweating challenges through unbelievably detailed indoor arenas and vast outdoor environments. As the ultimate techno-gladiator of the future, players will take their fates into their hands, battling against up to 32 other players online in action-packed, frag-filled arenas.
This launcher sets up the native Linux port of Unreal Tournament 2004 with additional fixes that make it work on a modern system. It needs the official game files to function properly.

Unreal Tournament is the original King of the Hill in the frag-or-be-fragged multiplayer gaming world. As the undisputed 1999 Game of the Year, Unreal Tournament grabbed the first person shooter genre by the soiled seat of its pants and knocked it around the room with its never-before-seen graphics, brutal edge-of-your-seat gameplay and a massive and varied feature list that gave gamers more than they ever expected.
This launcher sets up the modern native Linux port of Unreal Tournament from OldUnreal. It needs the official game files to function properly.

ET: Legacy is a downloadable, free-to-play multiplayer game in which players wage war as Axis or Allies in team-based combat. It's a team game; you will win or fall along with your comrades. The only way to complete the objectives that lead to victory is by cooperation, with each player covering their teammates and using their class special abilities in concert with the others.

Featuring multiplayer support for up to 64 players, ET: Legacy is the ultimate test of communication and teamwork on the battlefield. Players join the fray as one of five distinct character classes each with unique combat abilities. Each Axis or Allies team can divide itself into smaller fire teams for quick and easy communication using an intuitive messaging system and dynamic command map of the entire battlefield.
Based on the code of Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory which was released in 2010 under the terms of the GPLv3

component.name: EVE Preview Manager
component.summary: Utility for EVE Online multiboxing with real-time previews and hotkeys

description.p: EVE Preview Manager is a lightweight utility designed to enhance the EVE Online multi-boxing experience.
Key features include:

ul.li: Live Previews: Real-time thumbnails of all running clients.
Rapid Switching: Robust hotkey support to instantly switch focus between clients.
Customization: Configurable font, borders, colors, size, opacity, and more
Profiles: Save and load multiple configurations on the fly for different setups

description.p: NOTE: This application is not affiliated with CCP Games.
New:

ul.li: Added group dragging for all visible previews using LMB+RMB.
Added default preview position controls, screen picker, and reset for off-screen previews.
Added dedicated cycling hotkeys for unidentified login-screen clients, with optional cycle-group inclusion.
Added an option to show remembered character names on logged-out clients.

description.p: Fixed:

ul.li: Fixed minimize-on-switch and per-source exclusions when previews are disabled.
Fixed an X11 compatibility issue that could prevent minimized clients from restoring when selected by hotkey or preview click.
Fixed an evdev timing issue that could prevent hotkeys from focusing clients.
Fixed cycling edge cases involving logged-out and unidentified clients.
Fixed Toggle Skip when preview rendering is disabled.
Fixed cases where previews appeared or remained hidden incorrectly after character, focus, or visibility-setting changes.
Fixed hidden previews acting as invisible click targets.
Fixed conflicts when a custom source and EVE character shared the same name.
Fixed custom sources losing focus and resize tracking after redetection.
Prevented title-only custom-source rules from recursively capturing EPM preview windows.
Fixed client detection when EPM runs on a non-default X11 screen.
Fixed automatic position saves that could overwrite unrelated unsaved edits or character settings.
Prevented failed configuration loads from overwriting settings or leaving stale editor selections.
Added validation to prevent duplicate profile and cycle-group names.
Fixed malformed color handling and transparent text and border rendering.
Hardened backup creation, validation, restoration, and deletion.

description.p: Other:

ul.li: Added graceful preview-daemon shutdown and startup recovery.
Improved manager window and system-tray lifecycle reliability.
Made configuration writes atomic.
Added keyboard and mouse binding documentation.
Updated dependencies, Rust tooling, Nix packaging, and CI checks.

description.p: New:

ul.li: Added options to minimize the manager to the system tray and start the application minimized to the tray.
Added window titles to thumbnail previews for window manager rule support, using the format "EPM Thumbnail - {Character Name}".

description.p: Fixed:

ul.li: Fixed an issue where the mouse could jump to 0,0 over the NeoCom while rapidly cycling between clients.
Fixed an issue where logged-out clients could be detected as new windows when cycling with the minimize-clients feature enabled, causing previews to reset to their default position.

description.p: New:

ul.li: Minimize Client Override: Per-character and per-source control to exclude specific clients from being minimized when using the "Minimize EVE Clients" feature.
Preview Render Override: Per-character and per-source control to force preview rendering on or off, independent of the global preview rendering setting.

description.p: Fixed:

ul.li: Fixed hotkey cycling when previews are disabled entirely by decoupling hotkey authorization from thumbnail preview generation.

description.p: Other:

ul.li: Improved layout and usability of the Character Manager tab.

description.p: Fixed:

ul.li: Resolved mouse detection issues in recently focused EVE clients by forcing a cursor state refresh after window activation
Fixed previews flickering/redrawing when using the "Hide Thumbnails When EVE Loses Focus" option and cycling through clients
Resolved an issue causing the configuration file to be saved excessively
Improved window activation and focus reliability when using the "Minimize EVE Clients" option

description.p: Other:

ul.li: Optimized performance and stability with delta-based IPC for thumbnail updates and conditional font rebuilds, reducing input latency and focus thrashing when cycling clients at fast intervals

Make default window size 720p to avoid the window being too big on 1080p displays

Allow dashing from climb
reverted forward movement code to use the true camera position again.
Fixed the Speedrun Timer rounding hours up (ex. so 1.6 hours would display as 2 hours)
Fixed an OpenGL error on Linux (and probably Windows)
Fixed the FMOD Symlink's on Linux
Shows the Version Number on the Titlescreen now
Locale crash should be fixed
Being detected as a virus should be fixed; believe it was due to .NET version.

description.p: Step into the enchanting world of FaFa Runner: Dawn Legends, where an epic adventure awaits! Developed using Flutter and the Flame engine, this RPG delivers a seamless gaming experience with stunning visual effects.

Embark on your journey as a brave adventurer, explore mysterious lands, uncover hidden secrets, and face endless challenges. With rich story-driven quests and diverse character progression systems, every battle offers a unique sense of achievement.
Key Features:

ul.li: Dynamic Combat System: Enjoy intuitive controls and fluid action as you take on powerful enemies and formidable bosses.
Gorgeous Visuals: Experience vivid graphics and captivating animations, thanks to the powerful Flutter and Flame engine.
Rich Quest System: Engage in main quests and side stories, with each adventure offering surprises and challenges.
Customizable Character Growth: Tailor your hero with various skills and equipment to build the ultimate warrior.
Interactive World Exploration: Discover hidden treasures and secret locations across a fantastical map.

description.p: Join FaFa Runner: Dawn Legends and create your own legendary tale in this magical world. Download now and begin your epic adventure!
踏入《发发跑酷》的魔幻世界，开启一段前所未有的奇幻旅程！这款RPG游戏由Flutter和Flame引擎精心打造，为你带来流畅的游戏体验和绚丽的视觉效果。
在这里，你将化身为一位勇敢的冒险者，探索神秘的大陆，解锁隐藏的秘密，迎接无尽的挑战。游戏中拥有丰富的剧情任务和多样的角色成长系统，让你在每一次战斗中都能体验到前所未有的成就感。
主要特点：

ul.li: 动感十足的战斗系统：使用直观的操作，体验流畅的动作打击感，挑战各种强大的敌人和首领。
绚丽的视觉效果：利用Flutter和Flame引擎的强大性能，呈现精美的画面和生动的动画效果。
丰富的任务系统：从主线任务到支线剧情，每一次冒险都充满惊喜和挑战。
多样化的角色成长：自由定制你的角色，选择不同的技能和装备，打造最强的战斗力。
互动式的世界探索：探索充满奇幻的地图，发现隐藏的宝藏和秘密地点。

description.p: 加入《发发跑酷》，在这个奇妙的世界中书写属于你的传奇故事。赶快下载，开启你的冒险之旅吧！

Fastmail gives you full control of your communication, with speed, privacy, and tools that work the way you do.
The New York Times says:
”If you want something easy to use that isn’t tied to one of the big tech giants, Fastmail is a great option.”
Do more with email

ul.li: Stay connected anywhere – Read, draft, and search offline.
Powerful search – Find anything fast, even inside attachments. Plus, use the Search Refinement Toolbar to quickly add, remove, or adjust filters.
Declutter your inbox – Snooze emails, mute threads, block spam, and unsubscribe easily, and set up rules to automate your flow.
Stay organised your way – Use folders or labels to keep things tidy, and categorize messages without opening them.
Work smarter – Schedule or undo send, add private memos, set VIP-only notifications, and resize images in the compose window.

Sync seamlessly – Works with Google, iCloud, and more.
Always in sync – Updates instantly across devices, with full time-zone support.

description.p: Connected contacts

ul.li: Shared or private address books – Keep context from recent conversations and meetings.

description.p: Why Fastmail?

ul.li: Privacy first – No ads, no tracking, no selling your data. It’s your data, not ours.
Secure and trusted – Robust encryption of your data both in transit and at rest. Passkeys and 2FA keep your email private and safe.
No lock-in – Over 20 years delivering better email. People stay because it’s better, not because it’s hard to leave.
Real support – 24/7 online help from real people, no chatbots.
Migrate in minutes – Move mail, contacts, and calendars from your old provider in minutes.

description.p: Better for everyone – Fastmail supports open standards, keeping email private and usable for all.

description.p: Fog Panther is a professional image editor for people who take their craft seriously. Whether you are painting digital art, retouching photographs, designing graphics, or preparing artwork for print, it puts real, professional-grade power in a fast, focused application that stays out of your way.

Create without limits. Non-destructive layers keep your options open, precise selection and masking give you control over every detail, and a deep toolkit of brushes, filters, and adjustments is always within reach. Built to stay responsive on large, demanding images, Fog Panther helps you do your best work — and do it faster.

Fog Panther ist ein professioneller Bildeditor für alle, die ihr Handwerk ernst nehmen. Ob Sie digitale Kunst malen, Fotos retuschieren, Grafiken gestalten oder Druckvorlagen vorbereiten – er bietet echte Profi-Leistung in einer schnellen, fokussierten Anwendung, die Ihnen nicht im Weg steht.

Gestalten Sie ohne Grenzen. Nicht-destruktive Ebenen halten Ihnen alle Möglichkeiten offen, präzise Auswahlen und Masken geben Ihnen Kontrolle über jedes Detail, und ein umfangreiches Repertoire an Pinseln, Filtern und Korrekturen ist stets griffbereit. Fog Panther bleibt auch bei großen, anspruchsvollen Bildern reaktionsschnell und hilft Ihnen, Ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten – und das schneller.

Fog Panther es un editor de imágenes profesional para quienes se toman en serio su oficio. Ya sea que pintes arte digital, retoques fotografías, diseñes gráficos o prepares originales para imprenta, pone potencia profesional real en una aplicación rápida y centrada que no se interpone en tu camino.

Crea sin límites. Las capas no destructivas mantienen tus opciones abiertas, la selección y el enmascaramiento precisos te dan control sobre cada detalle, y un amplio conjunto de pinceles, filtros y ajustes está siempre a mano. Diseñado para mantener la fluidez con imágenes grandes y exigentes, Fog Panther te ayuda a hacer tu mejor trabajo, y a hacerlo más rápido.

Fog Panther est un éditeur d’images professionnel pour celles et ceux qui prennent leur métier au sérieux. Que vous peigniez des créations numériques, retouchiez des photographies, conceviez des graphismes ou prépariez des documents pour l’impression, il offre une véritable puissance professionnelle dans une application rapide et épurée qui ne vous encombre pas.

Créez sans limites. Les calques non destructifs préservent toutes vos options, la sélection et le masquage précis vous donnent la maîtrise de chaque détail, et une panoplie complète de formes, filtres et réglages reste toujours à portée de main. Conçu pour rester réactif sur des images volumineuses et exigeantes, Fog Panther vous aide à donner le meilleur de vous-même — et plus vite.

Fog Panther è un editor di immagini professionale per chi prende sul serio il proprio lavoro. Che tu stia dipingendo arte digitale, ritoccando fotografie, progettando grafiche o preparando file per la stampa, mette a disposizione una potenza davvero professionale in un’applicazione veloce e essenziale che non ti ostacola.

Crea senza limiti. I livelli non distruttivi mantengono aperte tutte le possibilità, selezioni e maschere precise ti danno il controllo di ogni dettaglio e un ricco corredo di pennelli, filtri e regolazioni è sempre a portata di mano. Progettato per restare reattivo su immagini grandi e impegnative, Fog Panther ti aiuta a dare il meglio, più velocemente.
Fog Panther は、仕事に真剣に取り組む人のためのプロ仕様の画像編集ソフトです。デジタルアートの制作、写真のレタッチ、グラフィックデザイン、印刷用データの作成のいずれにおいても、作業の邪魔をしない高速で集中できるアプリケーションに、本格的なプロの機能を備えています。
制限なく創作できます。非破壊レイヤーで選択肢を残し、精密な選択範囲とマスクであらゆるディテールを制御でき、豊富なブラシ・フィルター・色調補正がいつでも使えます。大きく負荷の高い画像でも快適に動作するよう設計された Fog Panther が、最高の仕事をより速く実現します。

O Fog Panther é um editor de imagem profissional para quem leva o seu ofício a sério. Quer esteja a pintar arte digital, a retocar fotografias, a criar grafismos ou a preparar trabalhos para impressão, oferece potência verdadeiramente profissional numa aplicação rápida e focada que não lhe fica no caminho.

Crie sem limites. As camadas não destrutivas mantêm as suas opções em aberto, a seleção e as máscaras precisas dão-lhe controlo sobre cada detalhe, e um vasto conjunto de pincéis, filtros e ajustes está sempre à mão. Concebido para se manter fluido em imagens grandes e exigentes, o Fog Panther ajuda-o a fazer o seu melhor trabalho — e a fazê-lo mais depressa.

description.p: A new brush engine with a Brush Settings panel, brush presets and Photoshop .abr import, bringing texture, dual brush, wet edges, color dynamics, airbrush build-up and smoothing to every paint tool. A new Photo Editor window, Properties, Color and Swatches panels, a Color Table dialog, Color Settings with bundled Adobe ICC profiles, and a new Export As dialog with side-by-side preview and file size estimate. Layer effects in PSD files render much more faithfully, including Bevel & Emboss contours, multiple drop shadows and choke, and masks gain Density and Feather. Free Transform, more faithful PSD text and previews in the file browser; in the native and AppImage packages, the browser also lists network locations and saves reliably to network shares. Fog Panther is now free to use without a time limit for work saved as .fog; a license unlocks the other formats, Export and Print.

Faithful Photoshop text import and export, live layer effects while editing text, and a smoother text tool. Documents now open asynchronously with a progress card and fit to the window instantly. Convert to and Assign Profile now work across the whole document with a color-managed canvas, a new CMYK Channel Mixer, physical dimension units with undoable resolution changes, and multi-stop gradient overlays. Smoother layer dragging on large documents, faster zooming, and many rendering and stability fixes.

Layer groups, a multichannel color mode with spot channels, true CMYK channel views, a command palette for quick access to any tool, recordable actions with batch processing, a new Warp transform tool, a dedicated Hand tool with flick panning, switchable ruler units, and high-dynamic-range image support.

Editable tone curve and color grading wheels in the Photography panel, more photographic adjustments available as adjustment layers, refined paste behavior, and additional memory and GPU stability fixes.

component.name: QuickAccess
component.summary: A global menu giving you quick access to folders and custom commands.

description.p: QuickAccess is a program running in the background providing a global menu to quickly access user defined folders and their subfolders as well as creating and running custom commands. The menu can be opened through two dbus methods: showMenu and showDelayedMenu. Both methods can open the menu in a predefined fixed position or on mouse position.

showMenu shows the menu instantly, but in certain circumstances there are problems with the menu not showing or not closing. In these cases use the showDelayedMenu, there is a default delay of 150 miliseconds, but can be changed (see example below).
Open menu with dbus-send
dbus-send --type=method_call --dest=com.georgefb.quickaccess /QuickAccess com.georgefb.QuickAccess.showMenu int32:x
dbus-send --type=method_call --dest=com.georgefb.quickaccess /QuickAccess com.georgefb.QuickAccess.showDelayedMenu int32:200 int32:x
Replace x with an int from 0 to 9 to set the preffered position to open the menu.
Check the project page for more info https://github.com/g-fb/quickaccess.

description.p: Mailspring is a new version of Nylas Mail maintained by one of the original authors. It's faster, leaner, and shipping today! It replaces the JavaScript sync code in Nylas Mail with a new C++ sync engine based on Mailcore2. It uses roughly half the RAM and CPU of Nylas Mail and idles with almost zero "CPU Wakes", which translates to great battery life. It also has an entirely revamped composer and other great new features.

Mailspring comes packed with powerful features like Unified Inbox, Snooze, Send Later, Mail Rules, Templates and more. Mailspring Pro, which you can unlock with a monthly subscription, adds even more features for people who send a ton of email: link tracking, read receipts, mailbox analytics, contact and company profiles. All of these features run in the client - Mailspring does not send your email credentials to the cloud.
